jobs.title: Staff Instrumentation & Controls Engineer, Deployment
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Crusoe is on a mission to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.

We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.

We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.

If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.

About This Role:

As Staff Instrumentation and Controls Engineer, Deployment - you will be a deployment and execution lead for the "nervous system" of Crusoe’s hyperscale data centers. You will spearhead the installation and integration of the sophisticated BMS/EPMS and SCADA solutions that allow us to monitor and control our high-performance computing environments with surgical precision. This role is fundamental to Crusoe’s mission: by successfully bringing online and integrating field-level HVAC, electrical, and monitoring infrastructure into a seamless, operational fabric, you ensure our AI-optimized cloud remains resilient, efficient, and scalable from day one.

This leadership position demands a technical authority who can bridge the gap between engineering design and on-site field execution. You won't just be maintaining systems; you will be driving complex rollouts, overseeing contractor integration, and implementing the deployment standards and commissioning frameworks that scale our global footprint. We are seeking a proactive problem-solver who thrives in a fast-paced, hands-on environment and is passionate about bringing automated systems to life, working with others, and driving consistency and efficiencies across our startup through operational handover. This is a full-time position.

What You’ll Be Working On:

  • System Deployment & Execution: Lead the field deployment, integration, and startup of automation solutions for BMS/EPMS systems, ensuring seamless integration and monitor with electrical, and cooling infrastructure.

  • Standardization & Implementation: Enforce system standards, frameworks, and deployment patterns for controls, BMS, and EPMS rollouts across multiple projects and sites.

  • SCADA & Graphics Configuration: Deploy and configure dashboards, HMIs, and operator workstations, ensuring site personnel have clear, functional visibility and control over complex building and power systems.

  • Startup Governance & Escalation Resolution: Oversee system integrators during standard deployments and point-to-point checkouts to ensure strict compliance with design standards, and operate as the controls escalation point to troubleshoot complex automation integration, system inconsistencies, and network integration issues.

  • Protocol Integration & Troubleshooting: Collaborate with design engineers, contractors, and OEM partners in the field to configure, integrate, and troubleshoot networks utilizing BACnet, Modbus, OPC-UA, and MQTT protocols.

  • Site Validation & Handover: Conduct system testing, simulation, Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT), and Site Acceptance Testing (SAT) to validate functionality, sequencing, and data accuracy prior to operational handover.

  • System Optimization & Turnover: Ensure controls platforms correctly collect and push real-time and historical data, enabling performance insight and analysis.

  • Site Support & Training: Mentor and train other controls engineers, on control system operation, troubleshooting best practices, and execution methodology.

What You’ll Bring to the Team:

  • Deployment & Integration Mastery: Extensive professional experience in the physical deployment, integration, and startup of PLC, SCADA, BMS, and EPMS platforms.

  • Mission-Critical Execution: Proven ability to successfully execute, deploy, and startup automation systems in data center or other high-availability environments.

  • Protocol & Networking Proficiency: Deep hands-on familiarity with configuring and troubleshooting control protocols such as BACnet, Modbus, OPC-UA, and MQTT, integrating diverse field devices into unified platforms.

  • Industrial Systems Literacy: Strong practical knowledge of HVAC, electrical systems, PLC/DDC logic, and industrial automation equipment operations.

  • Project & Field Leadership: Demonstrated ability to translate engineering designs into physical installations, driving deployment timelines, and navigating a fast paced construction environment.

  • On-Site Problem Solving: A track record of solving complex automation challenges, quickly diagnosing integration issues, and ensuring systems operate exactly as designed.

  • Mandatory Education: A Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Controls Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related discipline.

Bonus Points:

  • Advanced Academic Credentials: A Master’s degree in a relevant engineering or technical field.

  • Industry Certifications: Relevant professional certifications in specific PLC or SCADA platforms. Ignition and Rockwell preferred.

  • Cybersecurity Focus: Experience ensuring controls implementations comply with industrial cybersecurity best practices.

  • Sustainability Alignment: A passion for leveraging automation to meet company-wide energy efficiency and sustainability goals.

Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation and equity packages

  • Restricted Stock Units

  • Paid time off, paid holidays & leave of absence programs

  • Comprehensive health, dental & vision insurance

  • Employer contributions to HSA account

  • Paid parental leave

  • Paid life insurance, short-term and long-term disability

  • Professional development & tuition reimbursement

  • Mental health & wellness support

  • Commuter benefits (parking & transit)

  • Cell phone stipend

  • 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary

  • Volunteer time off

  • Global travel insurance & emergency assistance

  • Daily meals allowance

  • Additional perks & programs specific to location

Compensation Range

Compensation will be paid in the range of up to $148,000 -$170,000 + Bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicants knowledge, education, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.

Crusoe is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, citizenship, marital status, sex/gender, sexual preference/ orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, national origin, or any other status protected by law or regulation.

About the Role:

Crusoe Cloud is revolutionizing high-performance computing by offering sustainable, low-cost GPU compute power. As a Senior Manager, Customer Support, you'll play a crucial role in empowering our customers to leverage this technology for groundbreaking advancements in fields like AI/ML, physics simulations, and computational biology. You will be the primary point of contact for technical support, ensuring our customers can seamlessly utilize Crusoe Cloud to achieve their goals. This role directly impacts Crusoe's mission by enabling our customers to accelerate their research and development, contributing to a more sustainable future. You will be involved in exciting projects, working with cutting-edge technologies and collaborating with a talented team to solve complex challenges. The ideal candidate is a highly motivated and experienced technical professional with a passion for customer success, a deep understanding of cloud technologies, and a commitment to Crusoe's values. This is a full-time position.

You are invited to join and lead the Crusoe Customer Support Team full of highly talented, driven team members who care deeply about the success of our customers. One of our key priorities is to scale our Support Team’s ability to resolve deeply technical issues and support complex customers and workflows. That’s why we’re searching for a Support Engineering Manager to grow and shape the future of Support Engineering at Crusoe.

This role is not a traditional Support Manager position. We’re looking for someone who has technical depth, is confident diving into complex systems, and can mentor others on complex problem solving.

What You'll Be Working On:

  • Hire, lead and develop a team of Support Engineers focused on technical depth, problem-solving serving Crusoe’s enterprise customers

  • Provide thoughtful coaching and feedback to your direct reports, and partner with them on their career development goals and growth

  • Build scalable, repeatable processes for diagnosing and resolving complex issues related to integrations, APIs, analytics, and product performance.

  • Create internal tools and workflows that help the team operate with efficiency and consistency

  • Use data from escalations and customer feedback to recommend changes that improve team effectiveness and customer outcomes

  • Collaborate across functions, working closely with leaders in Solutions Engineering, Customer Success and Reliability, Sales, and Product Engineering to elevate and enhance the Crusoe customer experience

  • Directly engage and collaborate with key customers to understand their AI workloads, pain points, and future requirements to continuously improve our service offerings

  • Define and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) to evaluate team performance and effectiveness through leveraging multiple insights

  • Communicate clearly and effectively with your team, stakeholders, and external customers

What You'll Bring to the Team:

  • B.S. in Computer Science or a related technical discipline, or equivalent experience with an advanced degree in a related field

  • 6+ years of experience in Software Engineering, Technical Support Engineering, DevOps, Systems engineering, Solutions architecture or similar highly technical customer-facing roles

  • 2+ years in a leadership role within a high-growth environment

  • Deep understanding of the cloud infrastructure landscape, including fundamentals of Kubernetes, GPU compute, AI/ML, and high-performance computing

  • Proven track record of successfully organizing and coordinating the efforts of multiple teams to deliver long-running, complex projects with visibility to senior stakeholders

  • Passionate about improving the customer experience through well-designed, technically sound solutions.

  • Comfortable representing customer needs in Engineering discussions and advocating for supportability.

  • Expert leadership skills with the ability to influence and engage stakeholders at all levels.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with a strong capacity to clearly present complex technical information

  • Demonstrated experience within a fast-paced, dynamic organization experiencing hypergrowth.

  • Experience working with global teams

Bonus Points

  • Certifications: CKA, CKAD, CKS, KCNA, AWS Machine Learning - Specialty, Data Analytics - Specialty, Solutions Architect - Professional, Developer - Associate, NVIDIA AI Infrastructure and Operations, Generative AI and LLMs, Generative AI Multi-modal, Infiniband, Linux Foundation IT Associate, System Administrator.

  • Cloud Expertise: Deep understanding of specific cloud platforms and services.

  • Automation Skills: Experience with automation tools and scripting languages.

  • Problem-Solving Abilities: Demonstrated ability to analyze complex technical issues and develop effective solutions.

  • Collaboration and Mentorship: Proven ability to mentor, train, and onboard colleagues.

  • Passion for Sustainability: A strong interest in contributing to a more sustainable future through technology.

Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation and equity packages

  • Restricted Stock Units

  • Paid time off, paid holidays & leave of absence programs

  • Comprehensive health, dental & vision insurance

  • Employer contributions to HSA account

  • Paid parental leave

  • Paid life insurance, short-term and long-term disability

  • Professional development & tuition reimbursement

  • Mental health & wellness support

  • Commuter benefits (parking & transit)

  • Cell phone stipend

  • 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary

  • Volunteer time off

  • Global travel insurance & emergency assistance

  • Daily meals allowance

  • Additional perks & programs specific to location

jobs.title: Senior Staff Quality Control (QC) Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Crusoe is on a mission to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.

We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.

We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.

If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.

Overview

Crusoe is on a mission to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads.

We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power and infrastructure are the bottlenecks.

As a Senior Staff Quality Control (QC) Engineer, you will be the senior technical authority for construction quality across Crusoe's mission-critical data center campus. You will own the site-level quality strategy and set the standards, processes, and expectations that general contractors, trade partners, and internal teams execute against — from design review and equipment manufacturing through installation, inspection, commissioning readiness, and final turnover.

This is a high-impact, field-based leadership role at the intersection of construction, MEP systems, engineering, supply chain, and commissioning. You will lead through influence, mentor QC engineers and inspectors, and shape how Crusoe builds quality into its programs as we scale — because at our scale, quality directly drives uptime, performance, speed to power, and long-term reliability.

What You'll Be Working On

  • Own and lead the site-level QA/QC program for large-scale, mission-critical data center construction, serving as the senior technical authority on quality for the campus

  • Author, implement, and continuously improve the Site-Level Quality Management Plan, ensuring alignment with Crusoe's enterprise quality standards and contractual requirements

  • Define the standard for Inspection Test Plans, checklists, hold/witness points, and inspection workflows across all scopes; review and approve contractor ITPs and quality plans

  • Lead and perform complex field inspections across civil, structural, electrical, mechanical, controls, and commissioning-related scopes, with deep emphasis on critical MEP systems (medium/low-voltage distribution, switchgear, UPS, generators, liquid and air cooling, and controls)

  • Influence quality upstream by participating in design, constructability, and submittal reviews to identify quality and reliability risks before they reach the field

  • Partner with supply chain and OEMs on equipment quality, including factory acceptance testing (FAT), factory witness tests, source inspections, and receiving inspections for long-lead and critical equipment

  • Audit general contractor and subcontractor quality management systems; drive corrective action and hold partners accountable to contractual quality requirements, escalating when necessary

  • Lead coordination with AHJs and third-party special inspectors on code compliance, inspection sign-offs, and documentation requirements

  • Own the deficiency, punch list, and non-conformance (NCR) process through closure, including disposition of complex or high-risk NCRs in partnership with engineering

  • Partner with commissioning leadership to define and drive pre-functional and functional readiness criteria (L1–L5) and ensure systems enter commissioning with minimal rework

  • Lead structured root cause analysis (RCA, 5-Why, 8D, fishbone) for significant defects, failed inspections, and recurring issues, and ensure corrective and preventive actions are implemented and sustained

  • Establish quality KPIs and dashboards (first-time quality, NCR aging, rework rates, inspection pass rates) and use data and defect trends to drive measurable improvement

  • Capture and share lessons learned across Crusoe's portfolio, contributing to enterprise quality standards, templates, and specifications for future sites

  • Mentor and develop QC engineers, inspectors, and field teams, raising the technical bar and building a culture of quality ownership

  • Ensure turnover documentation — test reports, as-builts, O&M manuals, and quality records — is complete, accurate, and audit-ready

  • Communicate quality status, risks, and trends to project and executive leadership, escalating early to protect schedule, commissioning, turnover, and operations

What Success Looks Like

  • The site quality program is clearly defined, consistently executed, and recognized as a model for other Crusoe sites

  • Critical MEP systems enter commissioning ready, with measurable reductions in rework, failed tests, and late-stage defects

  • Quality issues are caught upstream — in design review, at the factory, or at receiving — rather than in the field

  • Contractors and trade partners consistently meet Crusoe's quality standards, with clear accountability and closed-loop corrective actions

  • Deficiencies, punch items, and NCRs are closed promptly, with quality KPIs trending in the right direction

  • Turnover documentation is complete, accurate, and audit-ready on first submission

  • Leadership has clear, data-driven visibility into quality status, risk, and readiness

  • Lessons learned are captured and adopted into enterprise standards, reducing repeat issues across the portfolio

  • QC team members grow in technical capability and ownership under your mentorship

Who You Are

  • 10+ years of experience in construction QA/QC, quality engineering, field engineering, or commissioning, including significant time leading quality on large-scale, mission-critical projects

  • Deep technical expertise in MEP systems, including medium- and low-voltage electrical distribution, critical power, mechanical/cooling systems, and controls

  • Proven track record building, owning, and improving site-level quality programs, QMPs, and ITPs on complex, multi-contractor projects

  • Extensive experience with field inspections, punch walks, NCR disposition, deficiency tracking, and contractor quality audits

  • Expert ability to read and interpret drawings, specifications, submittals, test reports, and applicable codes and standards (e.g., NEC, NETA, NFPA, IBC)

  • Demonstrated experience leading commissioning readiness, system turnover, and closeout on mission-critical facilities

  • Experience leading structured root cause analysis and driving sustained corrective and preventive actions

  • Ability to lead through influence and hold general contractors, subcontractors, and vendors accountable without direct authority

  • Strong executive presence and communication skills, with the ability to translate field quality data into clear risk and business impact for leadership

  • Data-driven mindset with experience defining quality metrics and using trends to drive continuous improvement

  • Experience mentoring and developing quality engineers, inspectors, or field teams

  • Strong ownership mentality, sound judgment, and the confidence to make and defend difficult quality calls in the field

Nice to Have

  • Data center, hyperscale, or AI infrastructure construction experience at multi-hundred-MW scale

  • Experience in complex construction environments such as semiconductor, healthcare, refinery, central plants, power generation, substations, or heavy industrial infrastructure

  • Experience with equipment manufacturing quality, factory acceptance testing, or supplier quality management

  • Experience building or scaling a quality program across multiple sites or a portfolio of projects

  • Familiarity with Procore, BIM360, Autodesk Build, Bluebeam, or similar construction management platforms

  • Relevant certifications such as ASQ CQE, CQM/OE, CQI, CQA, NETA, PMP, or similar

  • Experience with electrical, mechanical, controls, or integrated systems testing (IST) documentation

Additional Expectations

  • Willingness to be on-site full-time in Amarillo, TX

  • Ability to work closely with field teams, trade partners, OEMs, and commissioning teams in active construction environments

  • Ability to hold contractors and vendors accountable to quality standards, including escalation when necessary

  • Occasional travel to manufacturer facilities for factory testing and source inspections, and to other Crusoe sites as needed

  • Commitment to maintaining high standards in safety, quality, documentation, and execution

  • Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation and equity packages

  • Restricted Stock Units

  • Paid time off, paid holidays & leave of absence programs

  • Comprehensive health, dental & vision insurance

  • Employer contributions to HSA account

  • Paid parental leave

  • Paid life insurance, short-term and long-term disability

  • Professional development & tuition reimbursement

  • Mental health & wellness support

  • Commuter benefits (parking & transit)

  • Cell phone stipend

  • 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary

  • Volunteer time off

  • Global travel insurance & emergency assistance

  • Daily meals allowance

  • Additional perks & programs specific to location

Compensation Range

Compensation will be paid in the range of up to $175,000 – $215,000 + Bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicants knowledge, education, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.

Crusoe is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, citizenship, marital status, sex/gender, sexual preference/ orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, national origin, or any other status protected by law or regulation.

jobs.title: Director, Commercial Operations
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Crusoe is on a mission to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.

We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.

We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.

If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.

About This Role

The Director, Commercial Operations will be the operational backbone of Crusoe's Energy Development Group. This person owns the analytical frameworks, pipeline processes, and team capabilities that allow Crusoe to evaluate and advance land and power opportunities at speed and at scale. From complex financial modeling and market analysis to pipeline integrity and board-level reporting, this role ensures the BD team operates with precision and strategic clarity.

This is a leadership-first, analytically grounded role. The ideal candidate brings deep experience in energy project finance or development, a track record of building and mentoring high-performing analyst teams, and the process orientation to continuously raise the quality bar on how Crusoe evaluates and advances opportunities. You will work closely with senior leadership across Energy Development, Real Estate, Finance, Cloud, Energy Innovation, Design / Engineering, Pre-Construction, and Construction teams and will be a key contributor to the operational health of Crusoe's project pipeline.

What You'll Be Working On

  • Overseeing a team of Energy Development Analysts, setting the standard for analytical rigor, process discipline, and professional growth

  • Owning the development and refinement of economic models that underpin power origination and data center site pricing decisions

  • Driving continuous improvement of due diligence workflows, pipeline management processes, and reporting mechanisms across the Energy Development team

  • Overseeing the integrity and accuracy of Crusoe's data center opportunity pipeline, ensuring leadership has a reliable, real-time view of the project portfolio

  • Supervising the creation of board-level presentations, project approval materials, and executive communications that translate analytical complexity into clear strategic recommendations

  • Tracking and synthesizing hyperscaler activity, regulatory developments, and domestic energy infrastructure trends to surface actionable intelligence for the team

  • Supporting cross-functional collaboration between Energy Development and the Real Estate, Finance, Cloud, Energy Innovation, Design / Engineering, Pre-Construction, and Construction teams to move projects efficiently through the development pipeline

Core Responsibilities

Lead and enable the Energy Development Analyst team

  • Support, mentor, and develop a team of analysts, fostering a collaborative, high-performance culture

  • Provide hands-on guidance on financial modeling, market analysis, and project evaluation

Drive analytical quality and strategic relevance

  • Oversee the development of detailed economic models for new large-scale land and power opportunities and data center site power pricing

  • Ensure analyses of energy development potential and economics are accurate, rigorous, and decision-ready

  • Guide the team in leveraging internal data analytics tools and external market intelligence to identify and vet opportunities

Own pipeline management and process improvement

  • Drive continuous improvement of business operations processes within the Energy Development team, including project management, due diligence workflows, and reporting mechanisms

  • Maintain the integrity of Crusoe's data center opportunity pipeline, ensuring data accuracy and timely updates

  • Develop and implement best practices for tracking key pipeline metrics and project statuses

Deliver executive-ready reporting and communications

  • Supervise the creation and delivery of board-level presentations, project approval materials, and ad hoc reports for senior management

  • Ensure all communications clearly articulate analytical findings, strategic implications, and support for business decisions

Support cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder engagement

  • Facilitate effective communication between the Energy Development team and the Real Estate, Finance, Cloud, Energy Innovation, Design / Engineering, Pre-Construction, and Construction teams

  • Support the team in communications with external stakeholders including developers, IPPs, and potential partners

Monitor market and regulatory intelligence

  • Oversee tracking and analysis of hyperscaler and co-located data center activity, regulatory changes in the energy sector, and domestic energy infrastructure investments

  • Ensure the team synthesizes this information to identify potential impacts and opportunities for Crusoe

Qualifications

Required

  • 7+ years of progressive experience in consulting, project finance, investment banking, private equity, energy development, or business operations, with significant focus on the energy sector (renewables, conventional power, or oil & gas)

  • 3+ years of experience in a managerial or team leadership role, with a demonstrated ability to mentor and develop direct reports

  • Deep understanding of energy markets, project economics, and financial modeling

  • Exceptional analytical, quantitative, and problem-solving skills

  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Google Suite; experience with pipeline management systems

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to distill complex analytical and commercial content into clear, executive-ready recommendations

  • Demonstrated ability to build and improve operational processes in a fast-moving, high-ambiguity environment

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field

Preferred

  • MBA or relevant advanced degree

  • Experience with data center infrastructure, HPC, or large-scale power-consuming industries

  • Familiarity with power purchase agreements, offtake structures, and the commercial frameworks that govern energy project development

  • Experience with or strong aptitude for leveraging AI-based tools to drive analytical efficiency and output quality

  • Ability to travel domestically as required (estimated <20%)

Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation and equity packages

  • Restricted Stock Units

  • Paid time off, paid holidays & leave of absence programs

  • Comprehensive health, dental & vision insurance

  • Employer contributions to HSA account

  • Paid parental leave

  • Paid life insurance, short-term and long-term disability

  • Professional development & tuition reimbursement

  • Mental health & wellness support

  • Commuter benefits (parking & transit)

  • Cell phone stipend

  • 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary

  • Volunteer time off

  • Global travel insurance & emergency assistance

  • Daily meals allowance

  • Additional perks & programs specific to location

Compensation Range

Compensation will be paid in the range of up to $180,000 -$220,000 + Bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicants knowledge, education, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.

Crusoe is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, citizenship, marital status, sex/gender, sexual preference/ orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, national origin, or any other status protected by law or regulation.

 - Deep understanding of energy markets, project economics, and financial modeling

 - Exceptional analytical, quantitative, and problem-solving skills

 - Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Google Suite; experience with pipeline management systems

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to distill complex analytical and commercial content into clear, executive-ready recommendations

 - Experience with data center infrastructure, HPC, or large-scale power-consuming industries

About the Role

Crusoe is seeking a talented and motivated attorney to join our Legal team as Director, Legal Counsel, Corporate & Securities. This role is essential for building a best-in-class corporate legal function to support Crusoe's rapid growth and increasing complexity.

Reporting to the VP & Assistant General Counsel, Securities, you will be the primary legal point of contact for Crusoe's corporate governance, securities law compliance, and investor and regulatory reporting. This position offers a unique opportunity to have a direct impact on our company's trajectory, helping to build the governance and compliance infrastructure required for the next stages of our growth.

This role works in close partnership with our Director, Legal Counsel, Capital Markets. The two positions are designed to provide seamless cross-coverage for one another across the full corporate and securities mandate, and the ideal candidate is comfortable stepping into capital markets transactions when needed. The ideal candidate is a detail-oriented and pragmatic legal professional with significant law firm training and a desire to apply their expertise in a dynamic, in-house environment.

Corporate Governance & Board Support (Primary Focus)

  • Lead the preparation of materials for the Board of Directors and its committees, including agendas, presentations, minutes, and resolutions.

  • Manage the preparation and distribution of stockholder consents and notices, including vote threshold analysis.

  • Support the planning and execution of the annual stockholder meeting, including preparation of the notice and meeting materials, proxy and voting logistics, and coordination of meeting minutes and resolutions.

  • Advise on company governing and investor documents, including charter, bylaws, voting agreements, investor rights agreements, and right of first refusal agreements.

  • Help build and scale corporate policies, controls, and processes that mature with the company as it grows in size and complexity.

  • Maintain organized internal deal files and corporate records. Develop standardized templates, checklists, and playbooks to improve team efficiency and transaction consistency.

Securities Compliance & Regulatory Reporting (Primary Focus)

  • Lead the development and review of the company's securities-related disclosures and reporting materials, including periodic and event-driven reporting to investors and other stakeholders.

  • Develop and maintain disclosure controls, information governance, and communications protocols appropriate for a sophisticated, well-capitalized organization.

  • Advise on insider trading policies, equity transaction reporting, and related compliance processes for directors, officers, and other key stakeholders.

  • Monitor regulatory developments and ensure ongoing compliance with applicable securities laws.

Capital Markets & Financings (Cross-Coverage)

  • Provide backup and surge support on capital markets transactions — including equity and debt securities offerings— from diligence through closing.

  • Assist with disclosure schedules, ancillary documents, and KYC requests, and coordinate document flow with investors, banks, and initial purchasers during active deals.

  • Step in on transaction execution and post-closing covenant and reporting compliance as needed.

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Serve as a key legal advisor on corporate and securities matters to partners across the company, including Finance, Accounting, Investor Relations, and HR.

  • Translate complex legal and regulatory requirements into clear, practical guidance for business stakeholders.

What You'll Bring

  • Juris Doctor (JD) from an accredited law school and active membership in good standing in at least one U.S. state bar.

  • A minimum of 4-7 years of corporate and securities experience at a top-tier law firm, with a primary concentration in corporate governance, securities compliance, and regulatory reporting.

  • Deep subject matter expertise in board and stockholder governance, securities disclosure obligations, and insider trading compliance.

  • Working knowledge of capital markets transactions, including Rule 144A and other private placements, sufficient to provide cross-coverage for the Capital Markets function.

  • Proven track record of advising companies on complex corporate and transactional matters.

  • Exceptional attention to detail with strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Excellent business judgment and strong communication skills, with the ability to effectively advise and influence stakeholders at all levels.

  • Demonstrated ability to handle sensitive and confidential information with extreme professionalism.

  • A proactive, team-oriented mindset with the ability to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment.

  • Proficiency with Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, and AI tools (Claude, Gemini).

  • In-house experience at a technology or high-growth company is a plus.

Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation and equity packages

  • Restricted Stock Units

  • Paid time off, paid holidays & leave of absence programs

  • Comprehensive health, dental & vision insurance

  • Employer contributions to HSA account

  • Paid parental leave

  • Paid life insurance, short-term and long-term disability

  • Professional development & tuition reimbursement

  • Mental health & wellness support

  • Commuter benefits (parking & transit)

  • Cell phone stipend

  • 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary

  • Volunteer time off

  • Global travel insurance & emergency assistance

  • Daily meals allowance

  • Additional perks & programs specific to location

Compensation Range

Compensation will be paid in the range of up to $240,000 -$285,000 + Bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicants knowledge, education, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.

Crusoe is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, citizenship, marital status, sex/gender, sexual preference/ orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, national origin, or any other status protected by law or regulation.

About the Role:

We are seeking a Staff Software Engineer for our Billing team to design, build, and scale Crusoe Cloud’s billing platform. This role sits within the Cloud Customer Experience (CCX) organization and is critical to enabling accurate, transparent, and reliable billing for our customers.

 

You will own core billing systems end-to-end, from metering and pricing to invoicing and payments, ensuring they are highly reliable, scalable, and easy to understand. This role requires deep collaboration with Product, Finance, Customer Success, and other engineering teams to deliver a seamless and trustworthy billing experience.

What You'll Be Working On:

  • Own Critical Systems: Lead the design and operation of highly reliable billing services that directly safeguard revenue, eliminate data leakage, and maintain customer trust.

  • Drive Architectural Vision & Strategy: Own the technical roadmap for Crusoe Cloud’s billing domain, designing high-throughput metering, pricing, and invoicing architectures that scale with growing AI compute workloads.

  • Drive Accuracy & Transparency at Scale: Architect real-time and batch usage processing pipelines, immutable ledger models, and automated reconciliation engines to ensure absolute financial correctness and auditability.

  • Partner Cross-Functionally: Work closely with Finance, Product, Customer Success, and Support teams to align on requirements and translate complex enterprise pricing, commitment models, and business strategies into resilient platform capabilities.

  • Enable New Business Models: Design flexible, extensible billing capabilities and system modules to support rapidly evolving cloud offerings, dynamic pricing, and enterprise commitments.

  • Mitigate Systemic Risk & Improve Reliability: Establish robust safeguards, transaction standards, and automated verification workflows to proactively detect, isolate, and prevent billing discrepancies.

  • Drive Observability & Correctness: Elevate system observability, end-to-end reconciliation processes, and fault-tolerant error handling to guarantee billing state consistency across distributed systems.

  • Mentor and Lead: Set team engineering practices, drive design reviews, and mentor mid-level and senior engineers to build a high-performing engineering culture around financial data.

What You'll Bring to the Team:

  • Billing Systems Experience: Track record building and operating mission-critical billing, payments, high-throughput metering, or financial ledger systems (or similarly complex, high-integrity distributed data platforms).

  • Strong Ownership Mindset: Proven ability to own complex systems end-to-end, with an uncompromised focus on correctness, reliability, and long-term maintainability.

  • Professional Experience: 7+ years of software engineering experience designing distributed backend systems using languages such as Go, Java, Rust, or C++.

  • Distributed Systems Expertise: Experience designing and scaling fault-tolerant, low-latency distributed systems with strong data consistency guarantees, idempotency patterns, and immutable ledger architectures.

  • Data & Processing Knowledge: Familiarity with real-time and batch data processing, event-driven architectures, and data modeling for financial systems.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Proven ability to work closely with Product, Finance, and non-technical stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical capabilities.

  • Attention to Detail & Financial Integrity: Rigorous focus on financial correctness, edge cases, SOX compliance/auditability, and building safeguards to prevent revenue leakage.

  • Observability & Reliability: Experience establishing robust observability, automated reconciliation, and alerting frameworks across high-volume distributed environments.

  • Technical Leadership & Mentorship: History of setting team-level engineering practices, leading design reviews, and mentoring mid-level and Senior engineers.

  • Communication Skills: Ability to clearly explain complex architectural trade-offs, system constraints, and technical proposals to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation and equity packages

  • Restricted Stock Units

  • Paid time off, paid holidays & leave of absence programs

  • Comprehensive health, dental & vision insurance

  • Employer contributions to HSA account

  • Paid parental leave

  • Paid life insurance, short-term and long-term disability

  • Professional development & tuition reimbursement

  • Mental health & wellness support

  • Commuter benefits (parking & transit)

  • Cell phone stipend

  • 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary

  • Volunteer time off

  • Global travel insurance & emergency assistance

  • Daily meals allowance

  • Additional perks & programs specific to location

Compensation Range

Compensation will be paid in the range of up to $215,000 - $260,000 + Bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicants knowledge, education, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.

Crusoe is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, citizenship, marital status, sex/gender, sexual preference/ orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, national origin, or any other status protected by law or regulation.

jobs.descriptionHtml:

About This Role:

Join Crusoe Energy as a Manufacturing Engineering Manager and lead the team responsible for how our products are built. In this critical leadership role, you will oversee the manufacturing engineering department, driving the strategic optimization of our production facilities and processes for modular integrated electronics buildings and power distribution equipment.

You will be the operational counterpart to the mechanical and electrical engineering managers, ensuring that everything from complex switchgear to factory-built modular data centers is designed for manufacturability (DFMA) and transitions smoothly into high-volume production. The ideal candidate is a seasoned leader with a deep background in Lean and/or Six Sigma manufacturing, facility optimization, and team development in a fast-paced environment.

What You’ll Be Working On:

  • Team Leadership & Strategy: Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of manufacturing engineers. Oversee resource allocation across multiple production lines and NPI (New Product Introduction) projects to ensure production goals are met.

  • Production Strategy & Plant Optimization: Direct strategic initiatives to optimize plant layout, balance assembly lines, and maximize overall facility throughput.

  • CapEx & Equipment Strategy: Oversee project budgets and provide strategic direction on the procurement, installation, and commissioning of advanced manufacturing machinery and tooling.

  • Continuous Improvement: Champion a facility-wide Lean manufacturing culture (Value Stream Mapping, 5S, Kaizen); implement improvements to production methodologies to enhance safety, quality, and efficiency.

  • DFMA & Design for Excellence (DFx): Lead Design for Manufacturability and Assembly reviews with design engineering, focusing on cost reduction strategies and assembly simplification.

  • NPI Leadership: Own the manufacturing side of the NPI process, ensuring a seamless handover of production-ready 3D models from the design team to the factory floor.

  • Engineering Change Management: Oversee the implementation of Engineering Change Orders (ECOs), analyzing impacts on inventory, tooling, and labor to ensure smooth transitions.

What You’ll Bring to the Team:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Manufacturing, Mechanical, Electrical, or Industrial Engineering.

About This Role

We’re seeking a Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer to own the design, implementation, and lifecycle management of Crusoe’s enterprise cloud infrastructure across corporate and operational environments. This is a high-ownership, hands-on engineering role spanning Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Azure, and Azure Arc-enabled hybrid management. The role sits at the intersection of IT, Security, and site-specific operations to keep systems reliable, secure, and ready to scale with Crusoe’s rapidly expanding footprint of offices, warehouses, and data centers.

What You’ll Be Working On

  • Administer and optimize Microsoft 365 services (Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, Teams, OneDrive) and own Entra ID tenant health, including Conditional Access, MFA enforcement, and directory synchronization

  • Design and manage Azure infrastructure for corporate IT workloads (VMs, virtual networks, storage, and supporting PaaS services) with ongoing cost monitoring and rightsizing

  • Implement and administer Azure Arc to unify governance, policy enforcement, and monitoring across hybrid on-premises and cloud environments

  • Build and maintain infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Bicep, or ARM) for repeatable, version-controlled, and auditable deployments

  • Plan, rack, and commission physical server hardware at Crusoe data centers, CI facilities, and office sites during new builds and expansions

  • Administer Windows Server environments including Active Directory, DNS/DHCP, Group Policy, and certificate services, and manage Hyper-V or VMware virtualized workloads

  • Own monitoring, backup, disaster recovery, and incident response for all managed systems; participate in on-call rotation as the escalation owner for server, cloud, and identity incidents

  • Drive automation across infrastructure operations, maintain architecture and runbook documentation, and provide mentorship to junior members of the IT Infrastructure team

What You’ll Bring to the Team

  • 8+ years of hands-on infrastructure experience, with 5+ years focused on Microsoft Azure and M365 administration in enterprise environments

  • Deep Microsoft 365 tenant administration, including Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, Teams, OneDrive, and Entra ID (Azure AD)

  • Strong Azure infrastructure skills: VMs, VNets, NSGs, storage, ExpressRoute/VPN, and Identity and Access Management

  • Hands-on Azure Arc experience for hybrid server management and policy enforcement

  • Solid Windows Server administration: Active Directory, DNS/DHCP, Group Policy, certificate services, and file/print services

  • Infrastructure-as-code proficiency (Terraform, Bicep, or ARM) with version-controlled practices; PowerShell or Azure CLI scripting for automation

  • Ability to perform hands-on physical server work (racking, cabling, and firmware updates) in a data center environment

  • Strong troubleshooting, documentation, and cross-functional communication skills; bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience

Bonus Points

  • Microsoft certifications: AZ-104 (Azure Administrator Associate) or MS-102 (Microsoft 365 Enterprise Administrator Expert)

  • VMware vSphere experience alongside or in addition to Hyper-V

  • Linux server administration in hybrid Windows/Linux environments

  • Experience supporting new site infrastructure builds, coordinating with facilities teams, cabling vendors, and ISPs

  • Familiarity with SIEM/SOAR tooling and server and cloud log pipeline integration (Microsoft Sentinel or equivalent)

Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation and equity packages

  • Restricted Stock Units

  • Paid time off, paid holidays & leave of absence programs

  • Comprehensive health, dental & vision insurance

  • Employer contributions to HSA account

  • Paid parental leave

  • Paid life insurance, short-term and long-term disability

  • Professional development & tuition reimbursement

  • Mental health & wellness support

  • Commuter benefits (parking & transit)

  • Cell phone stipend

  • 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary

  • Volunteer time off

  • Global travel insurance & emergency assistance

  • Daily meals allowance

  • Additional perks & programs specific to location

Compensation Range

Compensation will be paid in the range of up to $125,000 - $150,000 + Bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicants knowledge, education, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.

Crusoe is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, citizenship, marital status, sex/gender, sexual preference/ orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, national origin, or any other status protected by law or regulation.

jobs.descriptionHtml:

About the Role:

We are seeking a Senior Staff Software Engineer for our Billing team to design, build, and scale Crusoe Cloud’s billing platform. This role sits within the Cloud Customer Experience (CCX) organization and is critical to enabling accurate, transparent, and reliable billing for our customers.

 

You will own core billing systems end-to-end, from metering and pricing to invoicing and payments, ensuring they are highly reliable, scalable, and easy to understand. This role requires deep collaboration with Product, Finance, Customer Success, and other engineering teams to deliver a seamless and trustworthy billing experience.

 

What You'll Be Working On:

  • Own Critical Systems: Lead the design and operation of highly reliable billing services that directly safeguard revenue, eliminate data leakage, and maintain customer trust.

  • Drive Architectural Vision & Strategy: Own the multi-year technical roadmap for Crusoe Cloud’s billing platform, designing high-throughput metering, pricing, and invoicing architectures that scale with growing AI compute workloads.

  • Drive Accuracy & Transparency at Scale: Architect real-time and batch usage processing pipelines, immutable ledger models, and automated reconciliation engines to ensure absolute financial correctness and auditability.

  • Partner Cross-Functionally: Work closely with Finance, Product, Customer Success, and Support teams to align and translate complex enterprise pricing, commitment models, and business strategies into resilient platform capabilities.

  • Enable New Business Models: Architect flexible, extensible billing capabilities and platform primitives to support rapidly evolving cloud offerings, dynamic pricing, and enterprise commitments.

  • Mitigate Systemic Risk & Improve Reliability: Establish robust safeguards, transaction standards, and automated verification workflows to proactively detect, isolate, and prevent billing discrepancies.

  • Drive Observability & Correctness: Elevate system observability, end-to-end reconciliation processes, and fault-tolerant error handling to guarantee billing state consistency across distributed systems.

  • Mentor and Lead: Set architectural practices, drive architecture reviews, and mentor Senior and Staff engineers across the organization to build a high-performing engineering culture around financial data.

 

What You'll Bring to the Team:

  • Billing Systems Experience: Extensive track record building and operating mission-critical billing, payments, high-throughput metering, or financial ledger systems (or similarly complex, high-integrity distributed data platforms).

  • Strong Ownership Mindset: Proven ability to own multi-year technical vision and complex systems end-to-end, with an uncompromised focus on correctness, reliability , and long-term maintainability.

  • Professional Experience: 9+ years of software engineering experience designing distributed backend systems using languages such as Go, Java, Rust, or C++.

  • Distributed Systems Expertise: Expertise designing and scaling fault-tolerant, low-latency distributed systems with strong data consistency guarantees, idempotency patterns, and immutable ledger architectures.

  • Data & Processing Knowledge: Familiarity with real-time and batch data processing, event-driven architectures, and data modeling for financial systems.

  • Cross-Functional & Executive Collaboration: Proven ability to work closely with Product, Finance, and non-technical stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical capabilities..

  • Attention to Detail & Financial Integrity: Rigorous focus on financial correctness, edge cases, SOX compliance/auditability, and building safeguards to prevent revenue leakage.

  • Observability & Reliability: Experience establishing robust observability, automated reconciliation, and alerting frameworks across high-volume distributed environments.

  • Technical Leadership & Mentorship: History of setting engineering standards, leading architecture review boards and mentoring Senior and Staff engineers to elevate overall organizational capability.

  • Communication Skills: Exceptional ability to articulate complex architectural trade-offs, system constraints, and strategic roadmaps to both technical teams and executive non-technical stakeholders.

     

Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation and equity packages

  • Restricted Stock Units

  • Paid time off, paid holidays & leave of absence programs

  • Comprehensive health, dental & vision insurance

  • Employer contributions to HSA account

  • Paid parental leave

  • Paid life insurance, short-term and long-term disability

  • Professional development & tuition reimbursement

  • Mental health & wellness support

  • Commuter benefits (parking & transit)

  • Cell phone stipend

  • 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary

  • Volunteer time off

  • Global travel insurance & emergency assistance

  • Daily meals allowance

  • Additional perks & programs specific to location

 

Compensation Range

Compensation will be paid in the range of up to $250,000 - $300,000 + Bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicants knowledge, education, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.

Crusoe is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, citizenship, marital status, sex/gender, sexual preference/ orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, national origin, or any other status protected by law or regulation.

jobs.descriptionHtml:

About the Role:

Crusoe Cloud is seeking a Sr. to Senior Staff level Solutions Engineer to work closely with our most strategic enterprise customers deploying AI/ML workloads on Crusoe’s high-performance GPU infrastructure. This is a hands-on, customer-facing role requiring deep technical expertise in Kubernetes, MLOps, and cloud infrastructure.

You’ll guide customers through end-to-end deployment—owning the PoC process, optimizing workloads post-sale, and serving as a critical technical voice between our customers and engineering teams. Ideal candidates are passionate about AI infrastructure, fluent in containerized environments, and confident in translating workloads across cloud platforms.

 

What You'll Be Working On:

  • Customer Enablement: Lead technical onboarding and deployment of complex AI/ML workloads with strategic enterprise customers—owning the POC through to post-sales optimization.

  • Kubernetes + MLOps Focus: Architect and deploy ML workloads using Kubernetes-based stacks (e.g., Ray, Kubeflow) Design infrastructure that balances performance, scalability, and efficiency.

  • Infrastructure-Centric Thinking: Go beyond abstracted services—deploy and optimize AI/ML workloads directly on Crusoe infrastructure. Ensure performance at the container and hardware level.

  • Cross-Cloud Translation: Help customers migrate and adapt workloads across AWS, Azure, and GCP. Understand and explain the tradeoffs between cloud-native and Crusoe-native approaches.

  • Technical Storytelling: Conduct workshops, live demos, and solution reviews. Contribute to case studies, solution briefs, and blog posts that highlight real-world customer success.

  • Voice of the Customer: Relay feedback to internal engineering and product teams to continuously improve Crusoe’s platform based on real-world implementation experience.

What You'll Bring to the Team:

jobs.descriptionHtml:

About the Role:

Crusoe is hiring a Developer Social & Content Manager to own our organic social presence end-to-end. Not just scheduling posts, but shooting and editing short-form video on-site at our offices and data centers, translating dense technical announcements (new GPU clusters, model training milestones, infrastructure launches) into content that lands with ML engineers, infrastructure leads, and AI researchers, and building a real following among the technical audience that actually cares about what we build.

This is a hands-on role for someone who thinks like a creator first and a marketer second: comfortable pulling out a phone at a product launch or an industry event and coming back with something worth posting, comfortable enough with AI/infrastructure concepts to write copy that doesn't get laughed out of a technical Twitter/X reply thread, and organized enough to run a real editorial calendar across channels.

What You'll Be Working On:

  • Own Crusoe's social channels (X/Twitter, LinkedIn, YouTube, and emerging platforms) end-to-end: strategy, content calendar, publishing, and performance reporting.

  • Shoot and edit short-form video yourself (on-site at data centers, at industry events, and in the office) no production crew required.

  • Launch Crusoe's TikTok from scratch and create native platform-specific vertical content for YouTube Shorts and Instagram Reels. This is a video-first, platform-native role, not repurposed clips from longer content.

  • Turn technical source material (product launches, research/benchmark results, executive commentary, customer stories) into social-native content that's accurate enough to hold up under scrutiny from a technical audience yet engaging enough to hold their attention.

  • Build and maintain relationships with AI/infrastructure creators, researchers, and technical journalists to expand organic reach.

  • Build social-native funnels that go beyond awareness. Use automation to move engaged followers through the same capture, nurture, convert logic we run on web, adapted to how people actually behave on each platform.

  • Source, brief, and manage a roster of contractors, freelance creators, and influencers who extend our content and campaign output, and build a user-generated content (UGC) pipeline that gets Crusoe's story told by voices beyond our own channels.

  • Monitor real-time AI/infrastructure conversation and react quickly when Crusoe has something relevant to add.

  • Partner with product, engineering, and exec stakeholders to source technical content and keep messaging accurate.

  • Be a fast, reliable partner to teams outside marketing who all lean on social for their own moments: People & Recruiting, Field Marketing/Events, PR/Comms, Workplace, and Exec/Leadership.

  • Track engagement, reach, share of voice (SOV), and follower growth against goals; report on what's working and adjust.

  • Represent Crusoe's brand voice: technical, credible, confident, humble, optimistic

What You'll Bring to the Team:

  • 4+ years managing social media for a technical, developer-facing, or B2B tech brand. AI/ML/infrastructure/cloud experience strongly preferred.

  • A portfolio of short-form video you've shot and edited yourself (phone-shot is fine - we care about instinct and pacing, not production value).

  • Genuine fluency with AI/ML and infrastructure concepts. You don't need to have trained a model, but you should be able to read a technical launch and know what's actually interesting about it.

  • Strong writing chops! You can write a thread that a CTO would retweet and an ML engineer wouldn't roast.

  • Experience running a multi-channel editorial calendar and reporting on performance.

  • Comfortable working independently, moving fast, and reacting to news in real time.

  • Intense operational rigor: strong attention to detail and organizational skills, with the ability to juggle multiple projects, requests, and posts at once without dropping the ball.

Bonus Points

  • Experience with community platforms (Discord, Reddit, Hacker News) relevant to the developer/AI audience and social media management tools like Sprout Social.

  • Existing relationships with AI/infrastructure creators, journalists, or influencers.

  • Basic motion graphics/editing skills (CapCut, Premiere, After Effects, or similar).

  • Prior experience at a GPU cloud, hyperscaler, or AI infrastructure company.

Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation and equity packages

  • Restricted Stock Units

  • Paid time off, paid holidays & leave of absence programs

  • Comprehensive health, dental & vision insurance

  • Employer contributions to HSA account

  • Paid parental leave

  • Paid life insurance, short-term and long-term disability

  • Professional development & tuition reimbursement

  • Mental health & wellness support

  • Commuter benefits (parking & transit)

  • Cell phone stipend

  • 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary

  • Volunteer time off

  • Global travel insurance & emergency assistance

  • Daily meals allowance

  • Additional perks & programs specific to location

Compensation Range

Compensation will be paid in the range of up to $130,000 - $160,000 + Bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicant's knowledge, education, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. (#INDCORP)

Crusoe is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, citizenship, marital status, sex/gender, sexual preference/ orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, national origin, or any other status protected by law or regulation.

jobs.title: Engineer, Load Integration & Model Development
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Crusoe is on a mission to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.

We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.

We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.

If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.

The Role

As an Engineer for Load Integration & Model Development at Crusoe, you will play a critical role in expanding our energy infrastructure and integrating our large-load facilities into the electric grid. You will be a key individual contributor, focusing on the complex challenges of connecting and optimizing our operations within the grid, including ERCOT, SPP, MISO, PJM etc.. This position requires deep technical expertise in power systems and a proactive approach to problem-solving in a rapidly evolving industry.

This role will be onsite 5 days a week at our San Francisco office.

What You’ll Be Working On:

  • Performing and supporting grid integration studies for large-loads.

  • Running technical power flow studies and supporting the submission of interconnection applications for Crusoe's facilities, ensuring technical data verification and sufficiency at various stages.

  • Managing transmission injection Performing load deliverability studies in ERCOT, SPP or MISO based on regional criteria.

  • Working with internal teams to understand project needs, drafting technical specifications, and supporting the business development team on the technical aspects of proposals related to grid integration.

  • Staying abreast of industry trends, attending conferences, and supporting other travel as required for projects and professional development.


What You’ll Bring to the Team:

  • Master's degree in Power Systems with 2+ years of experience or Bachelor’s Degree and 5+ years of experience in Power Systems.

  • Strong working knowledge of ERCOT or SPP or MISO interconnection procedures and transmission planning.

  • Working knowledge of TARA, PSS/e, Sugar.

  • Excellent communication, problem-solving, and report writing skills.

Bonus Points:

  • Experience with other ISO/RTO markets

Benefits:

  • Industry competitive pay

  • Restricted Stock Units in a fast growing, well-funded technology company

  • Health insurance package options that include HDHP and PPO, vision, and dental for you and your dependents

  • Employer contributions to HSA accounts

  • Paid Parental Leave

  • Paid life insurance, short-term and long-term disability

  • Teladoc

  • 401(k) with a 100% match up to 4% of salary

  • Generous paid time off and holiday schedule

  • Cell phone reimbursement

  • Tuition reimbursement

  • Subscription to the Calm app

  • MetLife Legal

  • Company paid commuter benefit; $300 per month


Compensation:

Compensation will be paid in the range of $125,000 - $145,000. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicant’s education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.


Crusoe is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, citizenship, marital status, sex/gender, sexual preference/ orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, national origin, or any other status protected by law or regulation.

About This Role:

As a Master Electrician with Crusoe’s Manufacturing team, you will be a key leader in ensuring the reliability and safety of our electrical systems. Your advanced expertise will be essential for overseeing the installation, repair, and maintenance of these systems, directly impacting the efficiency and safety of our manufacturing operations. You will leverage your deep understanding of electrical codes and best practices to interpret complex blueprints, troubleshoot challenging electrical issues, and implement innovative solutions. This role offers the opportunity to mentor other electricians, contribute to a dynamic team, and work with cutting-edge technology. The ideal candidate is a highly skilled and experienced Master Electrician with a proven track record of success, a commitment to safety, and a proactive approach to problem-solving. This is a full-time position. (#INDMFG)

What You’ll Be Working On:

  • Electrical System Oversight: Overseeing the installation of complex electrical systems in manufactured buildings, ensuring adherence to codes and specifications.

  • Troubleshooting & Repair: Diagnosing and resolving electrical problems, utilizing your deep expertise to implement effective and long-lasting solutions.

  • Preventative Maintenance & Optimization: Developing and implementing preventative maintenance programs for electrical systems to ensure their long-term reliability and optimize performance.

  • Code Compliance & Inspections: Ensuring all electrical work complies with relevant codes and regulations, and conducting inspections to verify adherence to standards.

  • Blueprint Interpretation & Planning: Interpreting complex electrical schematics and blueprints, and developing detailed plans for electrical projects.

  • Mentorship & Training: Providing guidance and mentorship to other electricians, sharing your expertise and contributing to their professional development.

  • Safety Leadership: Promoting a strong safety culture within the team, ensuring adherence to all safety requirements and OSHA guidelines.

  • Project Management: Managing electrical projects, including planning, resource allocation, and timeline management.

What You’ll Bring to the Team:

  • Master Electrician License: A valid and current Master Electrician license.

  • Extensive Electrical Experience: Significant experience as a Journeyman and Master Electrician, demonstrating a deep understanding of electrical systems and best practices.

  • Technical Expertise: Advanced proficiency in using a wide variety of electrician tools, techniques, and testing equipment.

  • Code Knowledge: Comprehensive knowledge of relevant electrical codes and regulations.

  • Leadership Skills: Demonstrated ability to lead, mentor, and train other electricians with a strong sense of self accountability.

  • Problem-Solving Prowess: Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to tackle complex electrical challenges.

  • Safety Compliance: Adhering to all safety requirements and OSHA guidelines to maintain a safe working environment.

  • Communication Skills: Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, to effectively interact with team members, contractors, and other stakeholders.

  • Physical Capabilities: Ability to perform the physical demands of the role, including lifting, bending, and working in various positions.

  • Safety and Compliance: This position is designated a safety-sensitive position and/or is located in a safety-sensitive facility. Drug and alcohol program participation is required.

Bonus Points:

  • Experience in a manufacturing environment.

  • Valid OSHA 30 certification

  • Experience with PLC programming or automation systems.

  • Certifications related to specific electrical systems or technologies.

  • Project management experience.

  • Experience with high-voltage systems.

  • Knowledge of NEC and other relevant standards.

About the Role:

Crusoe is seeking a Security Engineer to join the Security Engineering team as the primary driver for implementing security defaults and endpoint visibility. This is a strategic, architectural position focused on building secure-by-default endpoints that protect the organization as it scales. You will be responsible for security architecture, endpoint visibility, and maintaining our security posture across a rapidly growing global fleet of macOS, Windows, iOS, and Android devices. This role involves cross-functional partnership with Security and People Operations, with genuine scope to shape how Crusoe manages and secures endpoints. This role is onsite in San Francisco, CA, Sunnyvale, CA or Denver CO.

What You'll Be Working On:

  • Administer and continuously improve Jamf and Microsoft Intune environments across all managed device types: macOS, Windows, iOS, and Android; maintain configuration profiles, compliance policies, app deployment packages, and OS update enforcement across all platforms.

  • Build and maintain automated enrollment workflows including Apple Business Manager (ABM) and Windows Autopilot for zero-touch provisioning at scale.

  • Own a structured patch management program with clear SLAs for OS and application updates across all device platforms.

  • Define and enforce device compliance baselines aligned with Crusoe security standards and frameworks including CIS Benchmarks and SOC 2; integrate MDM telemetry with EDR and SIEM tooling for compliance drift visibility and proactive remediation.

  • Partner with Security on device trust policies, Conditional Access enforcement, certificate-based authentication rollout (SCEP/PKCS), and network-level access control for certificate-based Wi-Fi and VPN authentication.

  • Build and maintain scripts and automation in Bash, Python, or PowerShell to reduce manual IT workload; develop self-service tooling that puts routine fixes and software requests directly in employees’ hands.

  • Own MDM runbooks, device policy documentation, and asset records; contribute to the standardization of enrollment workflows, naming conventions, and configuration baselines across all platforms.

  • Serve as the MDM escalation point in the IT on-call rotation; partner with People Operations on seamless device provisioning and deprovisioning; mentor junior IT team members on endpoint management practices.

What You'll Bring to the Team:

  • Foundational Security Experience: Demonstrated experience with OSQuery and CrowdStrike (XDR/EDR) for endpoint visibility and threat detection.

  • Identity & Access Management: Deep understanding of Okta (Device Trust/FastPass) and Entra ID (Conditional Access).

  • MDM/Endpoint Management: 3–6 years of experience with Jamf/Kandji and Microsoft Intune (Autopilot, Compliance Policies, App Protection).

  • Independent Engineering: A "Security-First" mindset and proven ability to drive R&D initiatives from planning through implementation independently, with a focus on automating security controls.

  • Scripting & Automation: Proficiency in Bash, Python, or PowerShell for device policy automation, packaging, and remediation.

  • Infrastructure Knowledge: Strong understanding of certificate infrastructure (SCEP, PKCS) and experience with Absolute for Windows persistence.

  • Strong documentation habits, ownership mindset, and ability to communicate technical policies to non-technical stakeholders.

  • Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience.

  • OSQuery and CrowdStrike expertise , demonstrable experience leveraging OSQuery for endpoint visibility and administering CrowdStrike for threat detection and response; these are foundational to our security visibility and enforcement strategy.

Bonus Points

  • Jamf Pro administration experience: Smart Groups, configuration profiles, and Jamf Connect or equivalent SSO integration.

  • Experience with Jamf Protect, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, or equivalent EDR tooling.

  • Familiarity with Linux endpoint management via Fleet, Puppet, or similar.

  • Apple Certified Support Professional (ACSP) or equivalent MDM certification.

  • Exposure to SIEM tooling and endpoint log pipelines.

  • Experience at a high-growth technology company through a period of rapid headcount scaling.

Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation and equity packages

  • Restricted Stock Units

  • Paid time off, paid holidays & leave of absence programs

  • Comprehensive health, dental & vision insurance

  • Employer contributions to HSA account

  • Paid parental leave

  • Paid life insurance, short-term and long-term disability

  • Professional development & tuition reimbursement

  • Mental health & wellness support

  • Commuter benefits (parking & transit)

  • Cell phone stipend

  • 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary

  • Volunteer time off

  • Global travel insurance & emergency assistance

  • Daily meals allowance

  • Additional perks & programs specific to location

Compensation Range

Compensation will be paid in the range of up to $170,000 - $205,000 + Bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicants knowledge, education, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.

Crusoe is an Equal Opportunity Employer. jobs.descriptionHtml:

As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads.
