About the Role:

As a Senior Variable Compensation Manager, you will play a key role on the Total Rewards team, specifically providing strategic and operational support across Crusoe’s variable compensation programs. You will work closely with the Director of Variable Compensation, VP of Total Rewards, CPO, as well as other senior leaders at Crusoe to help design and deliver data-driven solutions that help us attract and retain top talent. This is a highly visible, hands-on role for a proactive and self-starting professional who will thrive in a fast-paced startup environment. This is a unique opportunity to build incentive programs from inception to operationalisation. To be successful in this role, candidates must have the ability to contextualise ambiguous requests, leveraging advanced analytical and modeling skills, in order to produce simple and reliable data driven insights. Ability to think outside of the box and deliver custom solutions is a major core competency.

What You'll Be Working On:

  • Incentive Program Design

    • Participate in the strategy, design, implementation and ongoing improvement of traditional (GTM) and non traditional incentive programs.

    • Lead end-to-end administration and governance of incentive programs - drafting plan documentation, modeling, achievement calculations, validation, and payout execution.

    • Serve as a point of accountability for incentive plan accuracy, compliance, and operational integrity.

    • Ensure all employees on a variable plan have a signed plan document in a smooth and trackable fashion.

    • Analyze program effectiveness, cost, and performance outcomes; proactively surface insights and recommendations to leadership.

    • Work on market research and cost modeling in order to help design competitive incentive programs for non-direct sales groups.

    • Partner with Finance, Accounting, and RevOps to ensure accurate compensation forecasting, accruals, and budget management.

    • Collaborate with the Internal Communications and HR team to effectively roll out and educate managers and eligible employees on variable compensation programs.

  • Data and Analytics:

    • Deliver complex modeling of ambiguous plan design.

    • Navigate data integrity issues in order to produce reliable insights.

    • Partner with HRIS and People Analytics to design, build, and maintain compensation dashboards that enable quick review of market positioning for short and long term incentives and budget utilization needs.

    • Help improve data integrity and optimize HR tech stack functionality for incentives tracking and accuracy.

    • Explore and pilot AI and automation tools to streamline repetitive tasks and enhance predictive analytics capabilities

    • Develop measurable metrics to track incentive program performance.

What You'll Bring to the Team:

  • Experience: 7+ years of compensation experience, with a mix of start up and large tech company experience. Fast pace start up experience preferred.

  • Experience with end-to-end ownership of incentive programs including design, modeling, and administration is a strong plus.

  • Experience with presenting and influencing senior leadership preferred.

  • Preferred Experience: Modeling/forecasting experience is a key competency.

  • Core Competencies: Deep knowledge of incentive-based compensation programs.

  • Skills: Exceptional analytical skills with a proficiency in spreadsheet software and experience with large datasets. Ability to navigate data integrity issues effectively in order to produce reliable dashboards and analytics. Strong communication skills with the ability to simplify complex concepts and present recommendations to diverse audiences, including senior leaders.

  • A proven ability to work autonomously and manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment.

  • Proficiency with HRIS systems (Rippling, Workday, Pave) preferred.

  • Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent initiatives

  • Experience working with senior leadership preferred

  • Competitive compensation and equity packages

  • Restricted Stock Units

  • Paid time off, paid holidays & leave of absence programs

  • Comprehensive health, dental & vision insurance

  • Employer contributions to HSA account

  • Paid parental leave

  • Paid life insurance, short-term and long-term disability

  • Professional development & tuition reimbursement

  • Mental health & wellness support

  • Commuter benefits (parking & transit)

  • Cell phone stipend

  • 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary

  • Volunteer time off

  • Global travel insurance & emergency assistance

  • Daily meals allowance

  • Additional perks & programs specific to location

Compensation Range

Compensation will be paid in the range of up to $175,000 - $215,000 + Bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicant's knowledge, education, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.

About This Role:

The Senior Staff Software Engineer for the AI Model Lifecycle team will play a crucial role in building a comprehensive managed platform for the entire application development lifecycle, with a specific focus on leveraging Machine Learning models, including Large Language Models (LLMs).

 

What You’ll Be Working On:

  • Manage fine-tuning systems for large foundation models (SFT, PEFT, LoRA, adapters), including multi-node orchestration, checkpointing, failure recovery, and cost-efficient scaling.

  • Implement and maintain end-to-end training pipelines for Large Language Models.

  • RFT and Reinforcement learning to the fine tuning and training sections

  • Distillation and reinforcement learning pipelines (e.g., preference optimization, policy optimization, reward modeling).

  • Dataset, model, and experiment management: versioning, lineage, evaluation, and reproducible fine-tuning at scale.

 

What You’ll Bring to the Team:

  • Advanced degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

  • 4-5+ years of industry experience leading and driving impactful projects in the AI Space

  • Experience in Generative AI (Large Language Models, Multimodal).

  • Hands-on experience training, fine-tuning, and aligning LLMs using Reinforcement Learning and Reinforcement Fine-Tuning (RFT) techniques.

  • Proactive and collaborative approach with the ability to work autonomously

  • Passion for building cutting-edge AI products and solving challenging technical problems.

 

Bonus Points:

  • Proficiency in Golang or Python for large-scale, production-level services and PyTorch

  • Contributions to open-source AI projects such as vLLM or similar frameworks.

  • Performance optimizations on GPU systems and inference frameworks.

 

Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation

  • Restricted Stock Units

  • Paid time off & paid holidays

  • Comprehensive health, dental & vision insurance

  • Employer contributions to HSA account

  • 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary

About the Role:

The Cloud Storage team at Crusoe seeks a Staff Software Engineer to lead the development and execution of our storage strategy. This role will be instrumental in driving innovation and performance improvements within our cloud storage infrastructure. You will work extensively with cloud storage primitives, utilizing advanced storage engineering concepts to build and operate high-performance, scalable, and reliable storage solutions.

What You'll Be Working On:

  • Lead engineering efforts on cloud storage features by collaborating with product and engineering to define and execute features on the roadmap.

  • Write and review code, generate and review design documentation. Participate in qualifications and rollouts of software across the stack journeying from bare metal to user-facing APIs.

  • Guide the engineering team through architecture decisions, design processes, design reviews, code reviews, and implementation tasks.

  • Mentor and grow engineers on your team, fostering an environment of teamwork and continuous learning.

  • Champion and lead initiatives across the engineering organization such as tech talks, open source development, and book clubs.

  • Benchmark, analyze, and improve scale, performance, and resiliency issues.

What You'll Bring to the Team:

  • Cloud Storage Expertise: Hands-on experience building and operating large scale, complex distributed cloud computing infrastructure products. Preferably, experience building redundant and fault tolerant storage solutions with backups, replication, encryption, and data protection mechanisms.

  • Software Engineering Fundamentals: Knowledge of professional software engineering practices and best practices for the full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations.

  • Technical Proficiency: Strong experience with at least one application programming language like Java or Go. Exposure to Infrastructure as Code tooling with any of Ansible, Chef, Puppet, and/or Terraform. Knowledge of Linux Systems Internals and computer architecture.

  • Communication & Collaboration: Strong communication and collaboration skills.

  • Safety and Compliance: Must be able to pass a background check.

Bonus Points

  • Storage Technologies: Hands-on experience with storage technologies such as NVMe, SSDs, and distributed storage systems.

  • Storage Protocols: In-depth understanding in at least one of block storage, object storage, and/or file storage. Familiarity with storage protocols like NFS, SMB, iSCSI, and NVMe-oF.

  • Open Source Contributions: Demonstrated track record of contributions to the open source community (e.g., Ceph, GlusterFS, OpenEBS).

  • System Programming: Proven experience in system programming with C, C++, and/or Rust.

  • Networking: An understanding of physical and software-defined networking concepts.

  • Education: Advanced degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation and equity packages

  • Restricted Stock Units

  • Paid time off, paid holidays & leave of absence programs

  • Comprehensive health, dental & vision insurance

  • Employer contributions to HSA account

  • Paid parental leave

  • Paid life insurance, short-term and long-term disability

  • Professional development & tuition reimbursement

  • Mental health & wellness support

  • Commuter benefits (parking & transit)

  • Cell phone stipend

  • 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary

  • Volunteer time off

  • Global travel insurance & emergency assistance

  • Daily meals allowance

  • Additional perks & programs specific to location

Compensation Range

Compensation will be paid in the range of up to $195,000-$245,000 + Bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicant's knowledge, education, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.

About This Role:

Crusoe is seeking a visionary and hands-on Senior Manager of Accounts Payable to join our dynamic finance team. In this critical leadership role, you will be the strategic architect responsible for building and scaling our entire procure-to-pay process for the future. As we experience rapid growth, you will drive process automation, implement best-in-class systems, and ensure our financial operations are as innovative as our technology. This is a unique opportunity to make a significant impact on Crusoe's foundation, ensuring efficiency and accuracy to support our aggressive expansion trajectory. This is a full-time position.

 

What You’ll Be Working On

  • Strategic Leadership & Vision: Develop and execute the long-term vision for the Accounts Payable function, focusing on scalability, efficiency, and accuracy to support rapid growth.

  • Operational Excellence & Oversight: Oversee the entire, full-cycle accounts payable process, including vendor onboarding, invoice processing, payment runs (ACH, wire, virtual card), and employee expense reporting (T&E). Ensure the accurate and timely processing of all invoices and payments.

  • Team Building & Management: Recruit, mentor, and lead a high-performing AP team. Foster a culture of excellence, collaboration, and continuous professional development.

  • Process Automation: Drive continuous improvement by proactively identifying and eliminating manual processes, integrating modern financial technology for peak efficiency.

  • Stakeholder Collaboration: Build strong cross-functional relationships with Procurement, Engineering, and other departments to ensure a seamless and efficient procure-to-pay experience across the entire organization.

  • Financial Controls & Compliance: Design, implement, and maintain robust internal controls to ensure strict compliance with GAAP, SOX, and company policies. Serve as the primary contact for AP-related audits.

  • Cash Management & Reporting: Partner with the Treasury and FP&A teams on critical cash flow forecasting. Develop and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) to track departmental performance, such as Days Payable Outstanding (DPO) and on-time payment metrics.

What You’ll Bring to the Team

  • Education & Experience: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field. You have 8+ years of progressive experience in accounts payable, with at least 4 years in a leadership role managing a team.

  • Growth Environment Success: Demonstrated success in a fast-paced, high-volume tech, SaaS, or startup environment is essential. You thrive in ambiguity and possess the proven ability to build processes from the ground up.

  • Systems & Automation Expertise: Deep, hands-on experience with ERP systems and AP platforms.

  • Leadership & Mentorship: A proven ability to lead, mentor, and effectively scale a team. You inspire your team and lead by example.

  • Analytical & Project Management Skills: Exceptional analytical, problem-solving, and project management skills. You are data-driven and can translate insights into actionable process improvements.

  • Communication: Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate with vendors and internal stakeholders at all levels.

Bonus Points

  • Direct experience with Sage Intacct and Coupa ERP and AP platforms.

  • Experience scaling the AP function for SOX compliance or IPO readiness.

  • Professional certifications such as CPA or CTP.

Benefits

  • Industry competitive pay

  • Restricted Stock Units in a fast growing, well-funded technology company

  • Health insurance package options that include HDHP and PPO, vision, and dental for you and your dependents

  • Employer contributions to HSA accounts

  • Paid Parental Leave

  • Paid life insurance, short-term and long-term disability

  • Teladoc

  • 401(k) with a 100% match up to 4% of salary

  • Generous paid time off and holiday schedule

  • Cell phone reimbursement

  • Tuition reimbursement

  • Subscription to the Calm app

  • MetLife Legal

  • Company paid commuter benefit; $300 per month

Compensation

Compensation will be paid in the range of $165,000 - $200,000 + Bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicant’s education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment

About the Role:

We’re looking for a Workplace Food & Beverage Manager to lead the next chapter of food at Crusoe: creating one aligned Food & Beverage strategy across every site type: offices, data centers, and manufacturing — and transitioning to an in-house lunch and catering partner who can support both daily meal programs and catering needs company-wide.

This is a foundational, high-impact role, you’ll shape our approach to food and beverage at every site, for years to come. You’ll own F&B strategy, guidelines, vendors, and budget end-to-end, partnering closely with Site Operations, EHS, and regional Workplace teams. Reports to the Director of Workplace.

What You'll Be Working On:

  • Define and lead Crusoe’s global Food & Beverage strategy, creating alignment across every site type — offices, data centers, and manufacturing — under one cohesive, scalable model.

  • Establish company-wide F&B guidelines and ensure offerings adhere to them at every site, covering food quality, dietary inclusivity, vendor standards, sustainability, and cost efficiency.

  • Transition Crusoe to an in-house lunch and catering partner that can support both daily meal programs and catering needs — All Hands, site events, and larger gatherings — consistently across every location.

About the Role:

Crusoe.ai is seeking a dynamic and experienced Senior Account Executive to lead our efforts in acquiring and expanding strategic accounts with leading AI labs in the AI/ML cloud infrastructure market. This role will focus on driving Crusoe's growth by engaging with frontier AI labs and model developers that require high-performance, sustainable cloud capacity at very large scale. You will be part of an innovative and rapidly growing company, working with cutting-edge technology that is transforming cloud computing by leveraging stranded energy resources to power AI workloads.

As a Senior Account Executive, you will play a pivotal role in scaling Crusoe's business, closing high-value, multi-year deals, and building long-term relationships with top-tier AI lab clients. You will own a portfolio of Named Accounts, with complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles that unfold over many months and multi-year commitments in the eight to nine figures. Your contributions will directly support Crusoe's mission to drive both growth and sustainability, making a significant impact in the AI cloud space.

This role will be onsite 5 days a week at our San Francisco office.

What You'll Be Working On:

  • Full Sales Cycle Ownership: Manage the entire sales process, from account planning and qualification to closing high-value, multi-year deals and maintaining long-term client relationships.

  • Collaborate Across Teams: Work closely with Solutions Engineering, Product, Engineering, Data Center, Finance, Legal, and Customer Success teams to deliver customized, high-performance cloud solutions.

  • Engage with C-Level Executives: Build and nurture relationships with key decision-makers across infrastructure, finance, and the C-suite at top-tier AI lab clients, positioning Crusoe as the preferred partner for their AI cloud infrastructure needs.

  • Target Key Accounts: Focus on a portfolio of Named Accounts across strategic AI labs, leveraging Crusoe's power availability, capacity at scale, and speed to deploy to meet customer needs.

  • Lead Complex Negotiations: Lead large, multi-year negotiations, including capacity commitments and complex commercial terms.

  • Drive Revenue Growth: Achieve sales quotas through new customer acquisition, and manage and grow accounts post-sale through capacity expansion and multi-year commitments to ensure continued customer success and satisfaction.

What You'll Bring to the Team:

  • 10+ Years of Enterprise Sales Experience: Proven track record in closing complex, multi-year sales cycles with eight-figure or larger deals, in Majors, Strategic, or Named Account roles, ideally selling cloud, infrastructure, data center, or AI compute at scale, with familiarity in working with hyperscalers like AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.

  • Deep Understanding of AI/ML Cloud Solutions: Experience selling advanced infrastructure products that support AI workloads, with the ability to understand client needs and provide tailored solutions, including capacity planning, power, and cloud economics.

  • Strategic Thinking & Negotiation Skills: Ability to negotiate large, multi-year contracts, including capacity commitments in the eight to nine figures, and navigate complex procurement, legal, and finance processes with senior counterparts.

  • Relationship Management: Experience owning Named Accounts and nurturing long-term relationships with AI lab customers, focusing on driving growth through account expansion.

  • Excellent Communication Skills: Ability to engage and influence senior stakeholders including C-suite and technical leaders, effectively communicate technical concepts to non-technical audiences, and collaborate cross-functionally.

  • Structured Sales Approach: A disciplined, value-based approach to account and deal management.

Bonus Points

  • Experience selling GPU or AI compute with capacity commitments

  • Hyperscaler or large-scale infrastructure background

  • Training in MEDDPICC, Command of the Message, or Force Management

  • Existing relationships with AI labs or their infrastructure leaders

Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation and equity packages

  • Restricted Stock Units

  • Paid time off, paid holidays & leave of absence programs

  • Comprehensive health, dental & vision insurance

  • Employer contributions to HSA account

  • Paid parental leave

  • Paid life insurance, short-term and long-term disability

  • Professional development & tuition reimbursement

  • Mental health & wellness support

  • Commuter benefits (parking & transit)

  • Cell phone stipend

  • 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary

  • Volunteer time off

  • Global travel insurance & emergency assistance

  • Daily meals allowance

  • Additional perks & programs specific to location

Compensation Range

Compensation will be paid in the range of up to $300,000 - $400,000 OTE. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicant's knowledge, education, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.

About This Role:

Crusoe is a vertically integrated AI infrastructure company with a mission to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence. Our competitive advantage—“Speed is the only moat”—is directly tied to our ability to rapidly design, manufacture, and deploy our own modular power and compute infrastructure.

We are seeking a Technical Program Manager to join our R&D organization and drive programs that evaluate and advance the next generation of AI data center technologies. You will manage initiatives that span multiple engineering disciplines—from early-stage technology evaluations and partnerships with emerging startups and industry providers, through pilot-scale validation and production handoff for hyperscale deployment.

Crusoe’s R&D team exists to look around corners: identifying the technologies and design approaches that will define future data center platforms, testing them rigorously, and delivering validated solutions to the engineering teams that build and deploy our infrastructure. As a TPM in his team, you will be the operational backbone of that process—coordinating across R&D, engineering, external technology partners, and leadership to drive programs from concept through pilot to hyperscale readiness.

 

What You’ll Be Working On:

  • R&D Program Execution: Own and drive R&D programs end-to-end—from early-stage technology evaluation and partner engagement through pilot-scale deployment and production handoff for hyperscale rollout. Bring structure, rigor, and pace to programs that are inherently exploratory.

  • Engineering Team Partnership: Serve as R&D’s program interface to engineering teams across the company. Coordinate joint planning, manage shared initiative pipelines, and ensure R&D outputs are aligned with the needs of the teams building and deploying infrastructure.

  • Technology Evaluation Support: Coordinate the operational aspects of technology evaluations: vendor engagements, test protocols, data collection, success criteria, and structured go/no-go decision frameworks. Ensure evaluations are completed on schedule with clear, documented outcomes.

  • External Partner Management: Manage relationships with external technology vendors, emerging startups, design firms, and development partners engaged in R&D programs. Own scope definition, deliverable quality, schedule accountability, contracts, and commercial terms. Help coordinate joint evaluations and pilot programs with industry and research partners.

  • Cross-Functional Coordination: Drive alignment across R&D, engineering, operations, and leadership stakeholders. Translate technical complexity into clear program milestones, risk registers, and decision points that enable rapid execution.

  • Program Reporting: Maintain program status visibility through regular reporting to R&D leadership and engineering stakeholders. Proactively identify and escalate risks and blockers.

  • Technical Documentation: Ensure R&D programs produce comprehensive documentation—including technical assessments, pilot results, vendor evaluations, and production handoff packages—that enable engineering teams to adopt and scale R&D-validated solutions.

     

What You’ll Bring to the Team:

  • Experience: 7+ years of progressive experience in technical program management, project management, or systems engineering, with a meaningful portion in data center infrastructure, manufacturing, or related industrial environments.

  • Technical Background: Engineering degree or equivalent technical foundation. You started your career as an engineer and transitioned into program management—you bring genuine technical fluency to every conversation, not just process discipline.

  • Data Center Knowledge: Working familiarity with data center infrastructure—power distribution, cooling systems, facility design, or compute/networking. You can engage credibly with engineers across these domains and ask the right questions.

  • Program Execution: Demonstrated track record of delivering complex, cross-functional programs on time. Comfortable managing ambiguity, competing priorities, and multiple concurrent workstreams.

  • Vendor Management: Experience managing external vendors, contractors, or design partners including contract negotiation, scope management, and delivery accountability.

  • Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills. Ability to translate technical program details into clear executive summaries and to facilitate productive discussions across diverse engineering disciplines.

     

Bonus Points:

  • Direct experience in data center construction, commissioning, or operations.

  • Background in manufacturing environments, particularly modular or containerized systems.

  • Experience with power systems, cooling technologies, or high-performance computing infrastructure.

  • PMP certification or equivalent program management credential.

  • Experience at a hyperscale cloud provider, major data center operator, or data center design/construction firm.

  • Prior experience in an R&D, advanced engineering, or new product introduction (NPI) environment.

 

Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation and equity packages

  • Restricted Stock Units

  • Paid time off, paid holidays & leave of absence programs

  • Comprehensive health, dental & vision insurance

  • Employer contributions to HSA account

  • Paid parental leave

  • Paid life insurance, short-term and long-term disability

  • Professional development & tuition reimbursement

  • Mental health & wellness support

  • Commuter benefits (parking & transit)

  • Cell phone stipend

  • 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary

  • Volunteer time off

  • Global travel insurance & emergency assistance

  • Daily meals allowance

  • Additional perks & programs specific to location

     

Compensation Range

Compensation will be paid in the range of up to $175,000 -$215,000 + Bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicants knowledge, education, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.

Crusoe is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, citizenship, marital status, sex/gender, sexual preference/ orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, national origin, or any other status protected by law or regulation.

jobs.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer, Storage DPU
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Crusoe is on a mission to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.

We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.

We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.

If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.

About the Role:

Crusoe is building a globally distributed, high-performance storage platform purpose-built for AI/HPC workloads.

We're looking for a Senior Staff Software Engineer to own how Crusoe's storage stack uses DPUs (NVIDIA BlueField-class SmartNICs) and related hardware offload to move that work off the host CPU and onto purpose-built silicon. This is a software-defined-acceleration role sitting at the boundary between our storage data plane and the physical network/compute fabric — you'll design and build the control-plane and data-plane software that lets Crusoe's storage stack take advantage of hardware offload for NVMe-oF, RDMA, and related protocol-level work, in close partnership with the Storage Networking and Compute/Hypervisor teams.

You will set technical direction for DPU/offload strategy within Storage, work hands-on across the host/DPU boundary, and partner closely with the storage-networking, and Compute hypervisor-level DPU function

 

What You'll Be Working On:

  • Hardware Offload for Storage Protocols: Design and implement software that offloads storage-protocol work (NVMe-oF target/initiator processing, encryption, compression, checksums, erasure coding) from the host CPU onto DPUs/SmartNICs, measurably reducing host CPU overhead per I/O.

  • Control-Plane Integration: Build and maintain the integration between Crusoe's storage orchestration layer and DPU-resident services, including provisioning, health/telemetry, and failover of offload paths.

  • Cross-Team Fabric Work: Partner with the storage-networking function on the RDMA/RoCE and NVMe-oF fabric work that DPU offload depends on, and with Compute/Hypervisor on SR-IOV/vDPA-based virtualization of DPU resources for multi-tenant isolation.

  • Vendor Framework Integration: Evaluate and integrate vendor DPU SDKs and frameworks (e.g., NVIDIA DOCA, BlueField SNAP) to accelerate storage virtualization (virtio-blk/virtio-fs offload) without building bespoke firmware from zero.

  • Observability & Testing: Build monitoring and testing infrastructure specific to DPU-offloaded paths — this is new surface area for the team, and strong tooling here determines how fast we can safely iterate.

  • Performance Benchmarking: Drive IOPS/throughput/latency benchmarking and quantify host-CPU-cycles-saved per offloaded operation, to make the case for where offload investment pays off next.

  • Technical Point of Contact: Serve as the storage team's technical lead on DPU-related architecture decisions, including with hardware vendors.

 

What You'll Bring to the Team:

  • 10+ years of professional software engineering experience, with deep, hands-on systems-level programming (C, C++, or Rust) and production experience in Go, Java, or similar for control-plane/orchestration work.

  • Direct, hands-on experience with SmartNICs/DPUs in production — NVIDIA BlueField (2/3), Intel IPU, ConnectX 6/7, or comparable hardware-offload platforms.

  • Working knowledge of NVMe-oF, RDMA/RoCE/InfiniBand, and the storage protocols DPU offload commonly accelerates.

  • Experience with kernel-bypass and hardware-offload techniques: SR-IOV, vDPA, virtio (virtio-blk/virtio-fs), XDP/eBPF, or DPDK/SPDK.

  • Strong Linux systems background — kernel internals, device drivers, I/O subsystems — sufficient to debug issues that span host, hypervisor, and DPU.

  • Experience contributing to at least one of file, block, or object storage systems, and genuine comfort working alongside (not reimplementing) mature storage data planes.

  • Demonstrated ability to work across team boundaries — this role sits at the intersection of Storage, Networking, and Compute, and will not succeed as a purely heads-down IC function.

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Engineering, or related discipline

Bonus Points

  • Direct experience with NVIDIA DOCA, BlueField SNAP, or other DPU-native storage-virtualization frameworks.

  • Experience building or operating NVMe-oF target/initiator offload in production.

  • Prior work on multi-tenant hardware isolation (SR-IOV/vDPA) in a cloud or hyperscale environment.

  • Familiarity with GPUDirect Storage or other GPU-to-storage data-path optimizations relevant to AI/HPC workloads.

  • Open-source contributions to DPDK, SPDK, Open vSwitch, or similar projects.

 

Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation and equity packages

  • Restricted Stock Units

  • Paid time off, paid holidays & leave of absence programs

  • Comprehensive health, dental & vision insurance

  • Employer contributions to HSA account

  • Paid parental leave

  • Paid life insurance, short-term and long-term disability

  • Professional development & tuition reimbursement

  • Mental health & wellness support

  • Commuter benefits (parking & transit)

  • Cell phone stipend

  • 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary

  • Volunteer time off

  • Global travel insurance & emergency assistance

  • Daily meals allowance

  • Additional perks & programs specific to location

 

Compensation Range

Compensation will be paid in the range of up to $245,000 - $290,000 + Bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicant's knowledge, education, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.

Crusoe is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, citizenship, marital status, sex/gender, sexual preference/ orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, national origin, or any other status protected by law or regulation.

jobs.title: Senior Staff Applied AI Inference Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Crusoe is on a mission to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.

We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.

We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.

If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.

About the Role

You will spend your time making large language models run faster, cheaper, and more reliably in production. That means owning the inference stack end to end: profiling where time and cost go, bringing modern optimization techniques into real deployments, and getting deep into the serving code when the defaults are not good enough. This is core systems and performance work on some of the most demanding models in use today.

 

The work is applied, not academic. The optimizations you build land in real customer deployments, each with its own models, traffic patterns, latency targets, and cost constraints. So while performance is the heart of the role, you will also work directly with customer engineering teams to tailor deployments to their needs, take a workload from an early proof of concept to a fully monitored production service, and make sure the gains you engineer actually show up for the people running the workload.

 

To set expectations clearly, this is a hands-on engineering role built around coding, profiling, and low-level optimization. It also carries a customer-facing side, along with elements of product and technical solutions work, because that is where the performance work gets proven.

 

What You'll Be Working On:

  • Bring current inference techniques into production and refine them.

  • Design and optimize serving architectures, including prefill and decode disaggregation, request routing, and related approaches.

  • Work down into the serving stack, from frameworks like vLLM and SGLang to the CUDA kernels underneath, profiling and running in-depth analysis to find and fix performance problems.

  • Adapt and scale optimization methods across many kinds of ML models, with an emphasis on large language models.

  • Profile and tune deployments against clear targets for latency, throughput, and cost, and keep them dependable under real traffic.

  • Tailor deployments to each customer's models and constraints, partnering with their engineering teams to move a workload from an early proof of concept through to a live, well-monitored production service.

  • Build and support the software and product features around the inference stack in a production setting, using one or more general-purpose languages, with Python preferred given how central it is to ML work.

  • Experiment quickly: take fuzzy goals, shape them into clear specs and focused proofs of concept, run fast experiments to find what works, and ship well-tested results without delay.

  • Own delivery end to end, from the first experiment through to the optimization running in production, keeping the underlying performance goals, clear specs, and follow-through front of mind, and drafting features and product requirement documents together with other engineering and product teams.

  • Work through ambiguity and make sound calls on tradeoffs and tooling, steering away from complexity that is not needed.

  • Take real pride and ownership in your work, hold yourself accountable, and look for the same from the people around you.

 

What You'll Bring to the Team:

  • A Bachelor's, Master's, or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field.

  • Hands-on experience shipping code in production with one or more general-purpose languages, such as Python or C++, with a strong preference for Python.

  • Familiarity with methods for optimizing LLMs for high throughput / low latency inference.

  • Comfort with modern LLM serving frameworks such as vLLM or SGLang, and with profiling and analyzing performance down to the kernel level.

  • A firm grasp of how GPUs are built and how they behave.

  • Clear interest and hands-on experience with large language models.

  • A working knowledge of AI/ML pipelines and the full path of developing and deploying ML models.

  • Strong communication skills, particularly when explaining hard technical topics to customers and teammates.

 

Bonus points:

  • A track record of making software systems run faster, especially for large language models.

  • Experience with CUDA or comparable technologies.

  • A strong command of software engineering fundamentals, with a record of building and shipping AI/ML inference systems.

  • Experience with Docker and Kubernetes.

  • Prior work building or tuning AI/ML projects, particularly in a customer-facing setting.

 

Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation and equity packages

  • Restricted Stock Units

  • Paid time off, paid holidays & leave of absence programs

  • Comprehensive health, dental & vision insurance

  • Employer contributions to HSA account

  • Paid parental leave

  • Paid life insurance, short-term and long-term disability

  • Professional development & tuition reimbursement

  • Mental health & wellness support

  • Commuter benefits (parking & transit)

  • Cell phone stipend

  • 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary

  • Volunteer time off

  • Global travel insurance & emergency assistance

  • Daily meals allowance

  • Additional perks & programs specific to location

 

Compensation Range

Compensation will be paid in the range of up to $250,000 - $300,000 + Bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicant's knowledge, education, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.

Crusoe is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, citizenship, marital status, sex/gender, sexual preference/ orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, national origin, or any other status protected by law or regulation.

jobs.title: Senior Staff Optics Engineer, Network Qualification & Strategy
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Crusoe is on a mission to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.

We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.

We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.

If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.

About This Role:

Crusoe is building the physical and software backbone that powers the world's most demanding AI workloads. Our networking team designs and operates the fabrics that connect thousands of GPUs into unified compute clusters, and increasingly the optical transport that connects those clusters to each other, to our PoPs, and to our customers. As Sr. Staff Optical Network Architect, you will define and build Crusoe's optical network strategy and architecture from the ground up, spanning data center interconnect (DCI), metro and long-haul DWDM, and the backbone that carries scale-across AI training and inference traffic between campuses. This is the first dedicated optical architecture role at Crusoe, with direct influence on how we acquire fiber, select platforms, and scale backbone capacity from tens to hundreds of terabits per second.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on optical architect who has designed and operated production DWDM networks at scale and can turn that experience into an architecture, a roadmap, and a team. You are fluent in Ciena and Nokia optical platforms, comfortable working through an OSNR budget or a fiber characterization report, and equally comfortable defending a multi-year capacity plan to executives. This is a full-time position reporting into Network Engineering, with the mandate to set optical strategy and grow the function as Crusoe scales its global footprint.

What You'll Be Working On:

  • Optical Network Strategy & Architecture: Define Crusoe's multi-year optical strategy and reference architecture across campus DCI, metro, regional, and long-haul segments, including line system design, ROADM topology, protection and restoration model, and failure domains.

  • Backbone & Scale-Across Capacity: Architect the transport layer for inter-campus and backbone growth from multi-Tbps today toward hundreds of Tbps, evaluating 400ZR/ZR+, 800ZR, and embedded coherent transponders (Ciena WaveLogic, Nokia PSE) against reach, density, power, and cost per bit.

  • Platform & Vendor Selection: Lead technical evaluation and selection of optical line systems and transponders. Drive RFPs, lab validation, multi-vendor interoperability testing, and second-source strategy.

  • Fiber & Route Strategy: Partner with infrastructure, real estate, and procurement on dark fiber, IRU, and wavelength acquisition, including route diversity, fiber characterization (OTDR, CD, PMD), and build-versus-buy decisions for new PoPs and campuses.

  • Optical Automation & Observability: Define how the optical layer is modeled in source of truth, provisioned, and monitored through open interfaces (OpenConfig, gNMI, TAPI, OpenROADM) and vendor controllers (Ciena MCP/Navigator, Nokia WaveSuite), so optical state is observable and reconciled rather than managed by hand.

  • Reliability & Failure Analysis: Own optical-layer failure modes end to end, including fiber cuts, amplifier and transponder failures, and gradual performance degradation. Lead RCA for optical incidents and drive design changes that reduce blast radius and time to restore.

  • Cross-Functional Partnership: Work closely with Network Engineering, SDN, data center design, NetOps, finance, and supply chain to align optical capacity with GPU cluster deployments, the backbone roadmap, and construction timelines.

  • Technical Leadership: Establish optical design standards, engineering documentation, and operational runbooks. Mentor engineers and help build out the optical engineering function as the network grows.

What You'll Bring to the Team:

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Optical Engineering, Physics, or a related technical field (Master's preferred).

  • 12+ years of experience in optical transport networking, including 5+ years as an architect or senior technical lead designing production DWDM networks at service provider, hyperscaler, or cloud scale.

  • Deep hands-on expertise with optical platforms, covering design, commissioning, and operational troubleshooting.

  • Strong command of optical fundamentals: OSNR and power budgets, EDFA and Raman amplification, chromatic and polarization mode dispersion, nonlinear impairments, flex-grid spectrum planning, and C+L band systems.

  • Experience with coherent technologies across pluggable (400ZR/ZR+, 800ZR) and embedded transponders, and a clear view of the tradeoffs between IP-over-DWDM and traditional transponder-based architectures.

  • Proven track record defining the architecture and roadmap for an optical network from early stage through scale, including capacity planning and cost-per-bit modeling.

  • Experience leading vendor evaluations, RFPs, and technical negotiations with optical platform vendors and fiber providers.

  • Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to make and defend architectural decisions with engineering, procurement, and executive stakeholders.

Bonus Points:

  • Experience building DCI or backbone networks for AI/ML or hyperscale data center environments, including scale-across training traffic between campuses.

  • Experience with open and disaggregated optical systems (open line systems, OpenROADM, TIP OOPT) and alien wavelength or multi-vendor interoperability.

  • Experience automating optical networks with NETCONF/YANG, OpenConfig, gNMI, or TAPI, and integrating optical telemetry into fleet-wide observability.

  • Experience with dark fiber acquisition, IRU negotiations, long-haul route engineering, or subsea systems.

  • Vendor certifications (Ciena OC-P or OC-C, Nokia Optical Network Professional) or participation in OIF, IEEE 802.3, or the OpenROADM MSA.

Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation and equity packages

  • Restricted Stock Units

  • Paid time off, paid holidays & leave of absence programs

  • Comprehensive health, dental & vision insurance

  • Employer contributions to HSA account

  • Paid parental leave

  • Paid life insurance, short-term and long-term disability

  • Professional development & tuition reimbursement

  • Mental health & wellness support

  • Commuter benefits (parking & transit)

  • Cell phone stipend

  • 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary

  • Volunteer time off

  • Global travel insurance & emergency assistance

  • Daily meals allowance

  • Additional perks & programs specific to location

About This Role:

Crusoe is building the physical and software backbone that powers the world's most demanding AI workloads. Our networking team designs and operates the fabrics that connect thousands of GPUs into unified compute clusters, and increasingly the optical transport that connects those clusters to each other, to our PoPs, and to our customers. As Sr. Staff Optical Network Architect, you will define and build Crusoe's optical network strategy and architecture from the ground up, spanning data center interconnect (DCI), metro and long-haul DWDM, and the backbone that carries scale-across AI training and inference traffic between campuses. This is the first dedicated optical architecture role at Crusoe, with direct influence on how we acquire fiber, select platforms, and scale backbone capacity from tens to hundreds of terabits per second.



The ideal candidate is a hands-on optical architect who has designed and operated production DWDM networks at scale and can turn that experience into an architecture, a roadmap, and a team. You are fluent in Ciena and Nokia optical platforms, comfortable working through an OSNR budget or a fiber characterization report, and equally comfortable defending a multi-year capacity plan to executives. This is a full-time position reporting into Network Engineering, with the mandate to set optical strategy and grow the function as Crusoe scales its global footprint.



What You'll Be Working On:

 - Optical Network Strategy & Architecture: Define Crusoe's multi-year optical strategy and reference architecture across campus DCI, metro, regional, and long-haul segments, including line system design, ROADM topology, protection and restoration model, and failure domains.

 - Backbone & Scale-Across Capacity: Architect the transport layer for inter-campus and backbone growth from multi-Tbps today toward hundreds of Tbps, evaluating 400ZR/ZR+, 800ZR, and embedded coherent transponders (Ciena WaveLogic, Nokia PSE) against reach, density, power, and cost per bit.

 - Platform & Vendor Selection: Lead technical evaluation and selection of optical line systems and transponders. Drive RFPs, lab validation, multi-vendor interoperability testing, and second-source strategy.

 - Fiber & Route Strategy: Partner with infrastructure, real estate, and procurement on dark fiber, IRU, and wavelength acquisition, including route diversity, fiber characterization (OTDR, CD, PMD), and build-versus-buy decisions for new PoPs and campuses.

 - Optical Automation & Observability: Define how the optical layer is modeled in source of truth, provisioned, and monitored through open interfaces (OpenConfig, gNMI, TAPI, OpenROADM) and vendor controllers (Ciena MCP/Navigator, Nokia WaveSuite), so optical state is observable and reconciled rather than managed by hand.

 - Reliability & Failure Analysis: Own optical-layer failure modes end to end, including fiber cuts, amplifier and transponder failures, and gradual performance degradation. Lead RCA for optical incidents and drive design changes that reduce blast radius and time to restore.

 - Cross-Functional Partnership: Work closely with Network Engineering, SDN, data center design, NetOps, finance, and supply chain to align optical capacity with GPU cluster deployments, the backbone roadmap, and construction timelines.

 - Technical Leadership: Establish optical design standards, engineering documentation, and operational runbooks. Mentor engineers and help build out the optical engineering function as the network grows.



What You'll Bring to the Team:

 - Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Optical Engineering, Physics, or a related technical field (Master's preferred).

 - 12+ years of experience in optical transport networking, including 5+ years as an architect or senior technical lead designing production DWDM networks at service provider, hyperscaler, or cloud scale.

 - Deep hands-on expertise with optical platforms, covering design, commissioning, and operational troubleshooting.

 - Strong command of optical fundamentals: OSNR and power budgets, EDFA and Raman amplification, chromatic and polarization mode dispersion, nonlinear impairments, flex-grid spectrum planning, and C+L band systems.

 - Experience with coherent technologies across pluggable (400ZR/ZR+, 800ZR) and embedded transponders, and a clear view of the tradeoffs between IP-over-DWDM and traditional transponder-based architectures.

 - Proven track record defining the architecture and roadmap for an optical network from early stage through scale, including capacity planning and cost-per-bit modeling.

 - Experience leading vendor evaluations, RFPs, and technical negotiations with optical platform vendors and fiber providers.

 - Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to make and defend architectural decisions with engineering, procurement, and executive stakeholders.



Bonus Points:

 - Experience building DCI or backbone networks for AI/ML or hyperscale data center environments, including scale-across training traffic between campuses.

 - Experience with open and disaggregated optical systems (open line systems, OpenROADM, TIP OOPT) and alien wavelength or multi-vendor interoperability.

 - Experience automating optical networks with NETCONF/YANG, OpenConfig, gNMI, or TAPI, and integrating optical telemetry into fleet-wide observability.

 - Experience with dark fiber acquisition, IRU negotiations, long-haul route engineering, or subsea systems.

As Crusoe scales and takes on increasingly complex financings, partnerships, and international operations, this role is the Company's subject matter expert on how those transactions are accounted for — analyzing new and unique deals for appropriate treatment and ensuring compliance with US GAAP and SEC regulations.

In this role, you will contribute to the preparation and review of the Company's external quarterly and annual financial statements, author the MD&A, drive the adoption of new accounting standards, and act as a strategic partner to internal business units and the primary liaison for external auditors on complex accounting positions. The ideal candidate is a licensed CPA with deep technical expertise, strong research and writing skills, and the ability to translate complex accounting concepts for non-financial stakeholders. This is a full-time, exempt position.

What You'll Be Working On:

  • Complex Transaction Analysis — Lead the research and evaluation of complex transactions, including debt/equity transactions, consolidation, lease accounting, revenue recognition, and other topics.

  • Technical Documentation & Leadership Communication — Prepare clear, comprehensive technical accounting memoranda documenting the Company's conclusions and compliance under US GAAP, and present the related accounting considerations to leadership.

  • SEC Financial Statements & Footnotes — Prepare and review aspects of the Company's quarterly financial statements and footnotes in compliance with SEC reporting requirements.

  • MD&A Authorship — Author the Management's Discussion and Analysis section to ensure clear, accurate narratives of financial results and trends.

  • Global Accounting Policy — Formulate global accounting policies and assist with the implementation of those policies across the organization.

  • New Standards Adoption — Monitor, analyze, and interpret new accounting pronouncements from the FASB, SEC, and other regulatory bodies to assess their impact on financial reporting, and drive the planning and implementation of new standards.

  • External Audit Partnership — Coordinate and engage with external auditors on the review of technical accounting positions, consolidated financial statements, and new accounting standards.

  • Internal Control Environment — Support the maintenance of a strong internal control environment (SOX compliance) over technical accounting and financial reporting processes.

What You'll Bring to the Team:

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting required.

  • Certified Public Accountant (CPA) certification required.

  • Six or more years of total accounting and audit experience.

  • Deep technical accounting expertise in US GAAP, SEC reporting regulations, and SOX internal control frameworks.

  • Strong analytical, research, and writing skills, with a proven ability to communicate complex accounting concepts to non-financial stakeholders.

  • Strong critical and analytical thinking skills, with the ability to identify issues and develop and implement practical solutions.

  • Ability to effectively manage multiple projects in a deadline-oriented environment.

Bonus Points:

  • Experience at a large public accounting firm (National Office or technical accounting group) or with a large corporate filer.

  • Direct experience drafting MD&A or other SEC narrative disclosures.

  • Experience leading the implementation of a major new accounting standard (e.g., ASC 842, ASC 606).

  • Familiarity with accounting for project finance, joint ventures, or other capital-intensive structures.

  • Industry experience in energy, infrastructure, or data centers.

  • Competitive compensation and equity packages

  • Restricted Stock Units

  • Paid time off, paid holidays & leave of absence programs

  • Comprehensive health, dental & vision insurance

  • Employer contributions to HSA account

  • Paid parental leave

  • Professional development & tuition reimbursement

  • Mental health & wellness support

  • Commuter benefits (parking & transit)

  • Cell phone stipend

  • 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary

  • Volunteer time off

  • Global travel insurance & emergency assistance

  • Daily meals allowance

  • Additional perks & programs specific to location

Compensation will be paid in the range of $115,000 - $140,000. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicant’s education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.

About the Role:

Crusoe is growing fast, and growth means change — expanding real estate, new workplace products, and new processes and ways of working across our global portfolio. We're looking for a Change Manager to deliver the people side of these transformations, ensuring that every employee, team, and leader is equipped, informed, and confident to embrace changes in the workplace. This role is critical to Crusoe's momentum: by minimizing resistance and driving adoption, you'll directly help our teams embrace change as a source of strength rather than disruption.

You'll partner closely with the workplace team and cross-functional partners to build readiness strategies, craft compelling communications, and coach employees through transitions — using proven frameworks like Prosci ADKAR to guide your approach. The ideal candidate is a strategic communicator and empathetic influencer who thrives in ambiguity, builds trust across all levels of an organization, and is energized by helping people navigate change successfully.

What You'll Be Working On:

  • Typical workplace change management projects include new office openings, office expansions, workplace tool launches, and workplace process changes. Beyond corporate offices, you'll also drive change management across Crusoe's manufacturing sites and data centers. For each project, you'll lead the following end-to-end change management activities:

    • Change Impact Assessment: Conduct comprehensive analyses that compare current state with future state to deeply understand how a given change will impact people, processes, and systems.

    • Change Strategy & Roadmapping: Develop change management plans and timelines to keep transformation initiatives on track and aligned with broader project milestones.

    • Readiness Assessments: Evaluate organizational readiness for upcoming changes and identify potential gaps before they become obstacles.

    • Leadership Alignment: Partner with senior leaders and front-line managers to activate them as visible, credible change sponsors who model the way forward.

    • Stakeholder Engagement: Partner with employees across all levels and teams to ensure relevant stakeholders are involved in the change journey.

    • Communication Design & Delivery: Create clear, compelling multi-channel communication campaigns that keep employees informed and engaged throughout each transition. Draft communication assets, lead the asset review cycle, and ensure timely delivery of messages.

    • Training Collaboration: Design and deliver targeted training programs that build employee capability and confidence.

    • Resistance Management: Anticipate friction points, proactively identify adoption risks, and coach people managers to help their teams move through change with resilience.

    • Cross-Functional Partnership: Serve as a trusted daily contact for teammates, project leads, and stakeholders across the business, ensuring alignment on change initiatives.

    • Metrics & Reporting: Track qualitative and quantitative adoption metrics to measure success and demonstrate the initiative's impact on business goals.

    • Travel: 10% domestic and international travel to our global offices.

What You'll Bring to the Team:

  • 5+ years of relevant experience in change management, organizational development, human resources, or project management.

  • Proven stakeholder influence in driving alignment and action without relying on direct authority.

  • Exceptional active listening skills, with the ability to read a room, surface concerns, and respond with empathy and clarity.

  • Comfort with ambiguity, adapting your approach as initiatives evolve and priorities shift.

  • Demonstrated experience leading change management for workplace or real estate projects, such as office moves, space redesigns, or facilities transformations.

  • Experience working as part of a collaborative workplace team, contributing to shared goals alongside cross-functional partners.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex change initiatives into clear, accessible messaging.

  • Experience driving change management in fast-scaling or high-growth technology companies.

  • Background partnering with executive-level sponsors on enterprise-wide initiatives.

Bonus Points

  • A Bachelor's degree in Organizational Psychology, Business Administration, Communications, or a related field.

  • Familiarity with Prosci ADKAR or other structured change management methodologies.

  • Management consulting experience.

Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation and equity packages

  • Restricted Stock Units

  • Paid time off, paid holidays & leave of absence programs

  • Comprehensive health, dental & vision insurance

  • Employer contributions to HSA account

  • Paid parental leave

  • Paid life insurance, short-term and long-term disability

  • Professional development & tuition reimbursement

  • Mental health & wellness support

  • Commuter benefits (parking & transit)

  • Cell phone stipend

  • 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary

  • Volunteer time off

  • Global travel insurance & emergency assistance

  • Daily meals allowance

  • Additional perks & programs specific to location

Compensation Range

Compensation will be paid in the range of up to $110,000 - $145,000 + Bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicant's knowledge, education, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Engineering - AI Inference
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Crusoe is on a mission to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.

We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.

We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.

If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.

About the Role:

As a Senior Engineering Manager, you will lead an engineering team focused on making large language models run faster, cheaper, and more reliably in production. While managing and growing the team, you will stay deeply technical and hands-on with the inference stack end to end: profiling performance, bringing modern optimization techniques into real deployments, and diving into serving code alongside your engineers. This role balances team leadership with core systems and performance engineering on demanding models in production.

The work is applied, not academic. The optimizations you build land in real customer deployments, each with its own models, traffic patterns, latency targets, and cost constraints. So while performance is the heart of the role, you will also work directly with customer engineering teams to tailor deployments to their needs, take a workload from an early proof of concept to a fully monitored production service, and make sure the gains you engineer actually show up for the people running the workload.

To set expectations clearly, this is an engineering leadership role that combines people management, technical direction, and hands-on coding and profiling. It also carries a customer-facing side, along with elements of product and technical solutions leadership, ensuring performance gains deliver clear business and customer value.

 

What You'll Be Working On:

  • Bring current inference techniques into production and refine them.

  • Design and optimize serving architectures, including prefill and decode disaggregation, request routing, and related approaches.

  • Work down into the serving stack, from frameworks like vLLM and SGLang to the CUDA kernels underneath, profiling and running in-depth analysis to find and fix performance problems.

  • Adapt and scale optimization methods across many kinds of ML models, with an emphasis on large language models.

jobs.title: Workplace Change Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Crusoe is on a mission to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.

We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.

If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.

About the Role:

Crusoe is growing fast, and growth means change — expanding real estate, new workplace products, and new processes and ways of working across our global portfolio. We're looking for a Change Manager to deliver the people side of these transformations, ensuring that every employee, team, and leader is equipped, informed, and confident to embrace changes in the workplace. This role is critical to Crusoe's momentum: by minimizing resistance and driving adoption, you'll directly help our teams embrace change as a source of strength rather than disruption.

You'll partner closely with the workplace team and cross-functional partners to build readiness strategies, craft compelling communications, and coach employees through transitions — using proven frameworks like Prosci ADKAR to guide your approach. The ideal candidate is a strategic communicator and empathetic influencer who thrives in ambiguity, builds trust across all levels of an organization, and is energized by helping people navigate change successfully.

What You'll Be Working On:

  • Typical workplace change management projects include new office openings, office expansions, workplace tool launches, and workplace process changes. Beyond corporate offices, you'll also drive change management across Crusoe's manufacturing sites and data centers. For each project, you'll lead the following end-to-end change management activities:

    • Change Impact Assessment: Conduct comprehensive analyses that compare current state with future state to deeply understand how a given change will impact people, processes, and systems.

    • Change Strategy & Roadmapping: Develop change management plans and timelines to keep transformation initiatives on track and aligned with broader project milestones.

    • Readiness Assessments: Evaluate organizational readiness for upcoming changes and identify potential gaps before they become obstacles.

    • Leadership Alignment: Partner with senior leaders and front-line managers to activate them as visible, credible change sponsors who model the way forward.

    • Stakeholder Engagement: Partner with employees across all levels and teams to ensure relevant stakeholders are involved in the change journey.

    • Communication Design & Delivery: Create clear, compelling multi-channel communication campaigns that keep employees informed and engaged throughout each transition. Draft communication assets, lead the asset review cycle, and ensure timely delivery of messages.

    • Training Collaboration: Design and deliver targeted training programs that build employee capability and confidence.

    • Resistance Management: Anticipate friction points, proactively identify adoption risks, and coach people managers to help their teams move through change with resilience.

    • Cross-Functional Partnership: Serve as a trusted daily contact for teammates, project leads, and stakeholders across the business, ensuring alignment on change initiatives.

    • Metrics & Reporting: Track qualitative and quantitative adoption metrics to measure success and demonstrate the initiative's impact on business goals.

    • Travel: 10% domestic and international travel to our global offices.

What You'll Bring to the Team:

  • 5+ years of relevant experience in change management, organizational development, human resources, or project management.

  • Proven stakeholder influence in driving alignment and action without relying on direct authority.

  • Exceptional active listening skills, with the ability to read a room, surface concerns, and respond with empathy and clarity.

  • Comfort with ambiguity, adapting your approach as initiatives evolve and priorities shift.

  • Demonstrated experience leading change management for workplace or real estate projects, such as office moves, space redesigns, or facilities transformations.

  • Experience working as part of a collaborative workplace team, contributing to shared goals alongside cross-functional partners.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex change initiatives into clear, accessible messaging.

  • Experience driving change management in fast-scaling or high-growth technology companies.

  • Background partnering with executive-level sponsors on enterprise-wide initiatives.

Bonus Points

  • A Bachelor's degree in Organizational Psychology, Business Administration, Communications, or a related field.

  • Familiarity with Prosci ADKAR or other structured change management methodologies.

  • Management consulting experience.

Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation and equity packages

  • Restricted Stock Units

  • Paid time off, paid holidays & leave of absence programs

  • Comprehensive health, dental & vision insurance

  • Employer contributions to HSA account

  • Paid parental leave

  • Paid life insurance, short-term and long-term disability

  • Professional development & tuition reimbursement

  • Mental health & wellness support

  • Commuter benefits (parking & transit)

  • Cell phone stipend

  • 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary

  • Volunteer time off

  • Global travel insurance & emergency assistance

  • Daily meals allowance

  • Additional perks & programs specific to location

Compensation Range

Compensation will be paid in the range of up to $130,000 - $160,000 + Bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicant's knowledge, education, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.

Crusoe is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, citizenship, marital status, sex/gender, sexual preference/ orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, national origin, or any other status protected by law or regulation.

About the Role:

Crusoe's Sales team is growing, and we're hiring a Finance Manager to build and run the financial governance program that supports our deal desk. As our compute business scales, deal volume scales with it, and this role exists to keep speed and control moving together instead of trading off against each other. You'll design the processes, policies, and tooling that keep pricing frameworks, deal approvals, and contract review moving fast, and you'll be the strategic finance partner Sales and RevOps come to on deal questions. Because you sit across the whole deal book, you're also positioned to spot trends in discounting and deal terms early, and to shape how the program evolves as the business grows.

What You'll Be Working On:

  • Develop processes and procedures to ensure financial governance of our deal quoting and approval workflow

  • Be a strategic business partner for Sales and RevOps on deal questions, drive creation of pricing options for standard-SKU deals, and create tooling to enable a term/prepay tradeoff framework

  • Review deals against policy and approve or route for further sign-off

  • Interpret contract language to flag terms that create financial, accounting or operational risk, and loop in Legal or Pricing when needed

  • Build and maintain reporting on discounting trends, deal cycle time, and policy exceptions

  • Take on ad hoc analysis for GTM and Finance leadership like understanding how deal terms are trending across the book of business or modeling the impact of a proposed change to the tradeoff framework

  • Partner with Sales, RevOps, Legal, and Product Finance to keep the deal process moving without creating bottlenecks

What You'll Bring to the Team:

  • 8+ years of experience in deal desk, revenue operations, sales finance, investment banking, or a similar analytical role

  • Demonstrated success in building and managing programs supporting the scalable operation of commercial workflows

  • Experience working with sales teams, ideally in an enterprise technology business

  • Comfortable reading contracts and identifying terms that matter financially, without needing a lawyer to translate

  • Fluent in Salesforce (or a comparable CRM/CPQ tool)

  • SQL proficiency (BigQuery or similar)

  • Good judgment about when to move fast on a standard deal versus when to slow down and escalate

Bonus Points

  • Experience in cloud infrastructure, compute, or another capital-intensive recurring-revenue business

  • Exposure to building or maintaining a pricing or tradeoff framework

Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation and equity packages

  • Restricted Stock Units

  • Paid time off, paid holidays & leave of absence programs

  • Comprehensive health, dental & vision insurance

  • Employer contributions to HSA account

  • Paid parental leave

  • Paid life insurance, short-term and long-term disability

  • Professional development & tuition reimbursement

  • Mental health & wellness support

  • Commuter benefits (parking & transit)

  • Cell phone stipend

  • 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary

  • Volunteer time off

  • Global travel insurance & emergency assistance

  • Daily meals allowance

  • Additional perks & programs specific to location

Compensation Range

jobs.descriptionHtml:
