jobs.descriptionHtml:
Crusoe is on a mission to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.

We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.

We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.

If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.

About the Role:

We're looking for a People Science Consultant to be the strategic analytics advisor to our People Success Partners (PSPs) and the leaders they support. You'll take on the complex, high-stakes questions that don't fit in a dashboard, and turn them into clear recommendations that shape decisions about talent, teams and organization.

You'll be embedded with our PSPs and the leaders they support, a trusted thought partner and data driven consultant. Through a mix of analysis, enablement, and partnership, you'll make sure insights land in the business and lead to real change.

The role is equal parts behavioral scientist and consultant. You'll bring research rigor to messy business problems, and the judgment to know which questions are worth answering.

You'll support a workforce few people analytics teams ever see. It spans a high-growth tech company, a distributed manufacturing operation, and a field organization building and running data centers internationally. What drives retention for a software engineer is very different from what drives it for a data center technician, and you'll help each part of the business understand its own people.

What You'll Be Working On:

  • Advise PSPs and business leaders

    • Serve as the dedicated analytics partner to our PSPs and their client organizations, such as Engineering, Data Center Operations, Manufacturing and G&A.

    • Take on complex questions, like transforming engagement results into meaningful change, or whether a reorganization will fix a team's execution problems, and turn them into focused analyses with clear recommendations.

    • Work from hypotheses: frame the question, decide what evidence would change the decision, and get to a credible answer quickly.

    • Help PSPs walk into business reviews, talent reviews and org design conversations with a point of view backed by evidence.

    • Help PSPs prioritize, and push back when a request won't lead to a decision.

    • Handle high-visibility requests, such as board materials, market comparisons and executive questions, with speed and accuracy.

  • Diagnose complex people problems and connect them to business outcomes

    • Lead deep dives when something changes, such as a spike in turnover at a site or a drop in engagement on a team.

    • Combine quantitative analysis with interviews, focus groups and open-text feedback to explain not just what is happening but why.

    • Analyze org health and structure, including span of control, layers and manager ratios, and assess the people impact of reorganizations.

    • Connect people data to business outcomes, such as how staffing stability affects site performance or how manager changes affect team retention.

    • Help leaders set realistic people targets for attrition, spans, ramp time and hiring quality, using internal history and external benchmarks.

  • Shape talent decisions

    • Provide analysis that supports performance calibration, including rating distributions, consistency checks and fairness reviews.

    • Measure whether the programs PSPs launch are moving the outcomes they were meant to move, and bring in our research partner when a program needs a rigorous evaluation.

    • Work embedded in the business

      • Join PSP and leadership forums so you understand each organization's priorities and spot people issues early.

      • Turn work from the wider People Science and Workforce Intelligence team into recommendations leaders can act on, and bring real business problems back to shape the research and capability roadmap.

      • Make sure PSPs and leaders know the full range of what the team can do, including the self-service tools they already have, and help them use it.

      • Build data fluency across the PSP team by coaching partners to read data with confidence and use the team's tools on their own.

      • Make sure conclusions are sound and clearly separate what the data show from what it suggests.

What You'll Bring to the Team:

  • An advanced degree in a behavioral science or quantitative field, such as I/O Psychology, Behavioral Economics, Organizational Behavior, Statistics or Economics, or a master’s degree plus substantial experience in management consulting or analytics.

  • 4+ years in people analytics, management consulting or a related analytical role, including time spent advising senior leaders directly

  • Solid grounding in research design and inferential statistics, so you can tell a real effect from noise and explain the difference to a skeptical executive.

  • Strong Exploratory Data Analysis skills. You're comfortable getting into the data yourself to answer a question.

  • Consulting skills: you can scope an unclear request, manage several stakeholders, and say no when it's the right call.

  • A strong grasp of HR processes and people metrics, including where metrics mislead and need deeper analysis.

  • The ability to explain complex analysis to non-technical audiences, from PSPs to senior executives.

  • Hands-on experience using AI tools to speed up analysis or build lightweight tools, not just curiosity about them.

  • Comfort with ambiguity and a fast pace. You'd rather deliver a useful answer this week than a perfect one next quarter.

Bonus Points

  • Experience in management consulting, internal strategy or a similar role where you owned the full arc of a problem: framing the question, forming hypotheses, doing the analysis and getting leaders to act.

  • Experience with Python or R.

  • Experience with qualitative research methods, such as interviews and focus groups.

  • Experience supporting frontline, manufacturing, field or operations workforces.

  • Experience at a high-growth technology, AI/ML, energy or infrastructure company.

  • Experience with BigQuery, dbt and Sigma.

  • Experience with Workday, position management concepts, and listening platforms

Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation and equity packages

  • Restricted Stock Units

  • Paid time off, paid holidays & leave of absence programs

  • Comprehensive health, dental & vision insurance

  • Employer contributions to HSA account

  • Paid parental leave

  • Paid life insurance, short-term and long-term disability

  • Professional development & tuition reimbursement

  • Mental health & wellness support

  • Commuter benefits (parking & transit)

  • Cell phone stipend

  • 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary

  • Volunteer time off

  • Global travel insurance & emergency assistance

  • Daily meals allowance

  • Additional perks & programs specific to location

Compensation Range

Compensation will be paid in the range of up to $140,000 - $170,000 + Bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicant's knowledge, education, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.

Crusoe is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, citizenship, marital status, sex/gender, sexual preference/ orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, national origin, or any other status protected by law or regulation.

About the Role:
At Crusoe, our Site Reliability Engineering team ensures the reliability and scalability of Crusoe’s AI-optimized cloud platform. We’re looking for a Staff Site Reliability Engineer with a strong background in distributed systems and hands-on experience with large language models to help us build and operate managed AI services at scale. This role is central to delivering highly available, performant, and cost-efficient AI infrastructure that powers compute-intensive, latency-sensitive workloads for our customers.

What You’ll Work On:

  • Design and operate reliable managed AI services with a focus on serving and scaling LLM workloads

  • Build automation and reliability tooling to support distributed AI pipelines and inference services

  • Define, measure, and improve SLIs/SLOs across AI workloads to ensure performance and reliability targets are met

  • Collaborate with AI, platform, and infrastructure teams to optimize large-scale training and inference clusters

  • Automate observability by building telemetry and performance tuning strategies for latency-sensitive AI services

  • Investigate and resolve reliability issues in distributed AI systems using telemetry, logs, and profiling

  • Contribute to the architecture of next-generation distributed systems purpose-built for AI-first environments

What You’ll Bring:

  • Strong software engineering background — experience building production-grade systems beyond scripting or Bash

  • Demonstrated experience in distributed systems design and implementation

  • Hands-on work with large language models (LLMs) or AI/ML infrastructure

  • SRE mindset and experience (whether or not under the SRE title) including:

    • Defining and measuring SLIs/SLOs

    • Building monitoring and observability systems

    • Driving performance and reliability improvements

    • Designing fault-tolerant systems and automated testing strategies

  • Proficiency in at least one modern programming language (Python, Go, Java, C++)

  • Deep working knowledge of Kubernetes (cluster architecture, networking, scheduling, and workload management)

  • Strong collaboration and communication skills

  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, mission-driven environment

Bonus Points:

  • Experience scaling inference or training workloads for LLMs

Benefits:

Crusoe also offers a competitive benefits package designed to support financial security, health, and overall well-being. Our benefits are tailored to local market standards and include core offerings such as pension contributions and additional perks to support work-life balance.

Crusoe is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, citizenship, marital status, sex/gender, sexual preference/ orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, national origin, or any other status protected by law or regulation.

Crusoe is on a mission to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.

We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.

We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.

If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.

About the Role:

Crusoe is building the world's favorite AI-first cloud, and the Identity & Access Management (IAM) team is the security bedrock our customers trust to run their most demanding AI and GPU workloads. IAM sits on the hot path for every request in the cloud, authorizing millions of requests at single-digit-millisecond latency, so reliability and performance are non-negotiable. We are seeking seasoned Senior Software Engineers to design, build, and scale this platform: the fine-grained authorization model for Crusoe Cloud resources, enterprise SSO and identity federation, multi-tenant organization hierarchies, identity for the agentic-AI era, and credential and secrets management. As a Senior Engineer, you'll own the design and delivery of significant IAM services end-to-end, partner across teams, and help raise the technical bar through mentorship and code review.

What You'll Be Working On:

  • Design and Deliver IAM Services - Own the end-to-end design, development, and operation of core IAM services - fine-grained authorization, authentication, identity federation, and identity lifecycle - that secure every request in Crusoe's AI cloud.

  • Solve Complex AuthN/AuthZ Problems - Design and build solutions to complex authentication and authorization scenarios at the platform level, including the fine-grained authorization model for accessing Crusoe Cloud resources.

  • Engineer for the Hot Path - Deliver low-latency, fault-tolerant services that remain highly available under load, since IAM is on the critical path for every API call.

  • Harden Security Posture - Apply security best practices such as OAuth2/OIDC, RBAC/ABAC, and session and credential management across the services you own.

  • Contribute to Architecture - Contribute to architectural decisions that support security, reliability, and maintainability across the company.

  • Collaborate Across Teams - Work with product, design, security, and SRE to evaluate tools, frameworks, and customer needs, aligning priorities to ship customer-first solutions.

  • Mentor and Elevate - Mentor engineers, enhance hiring and onboarding practices, perform code reviews, and contribute to a strong, inclusive engineering culture.

What You'll Bring to the Team:

  • Education & Experience - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field (or equivalent practical experience) and 5+ years of software development experience, primarily in Go and gRPC (or an equivalent compiled language).

  • Distributed Systems Expertise - Proven ability to design and scale fault-tolerant distributed systems and develop managed cloud services.

  • Security & Identity Expertise - Hands-on experience building authentication and authorization into production services - OAuth2/OIDC, RBAC/ABAC, and session, credential, and secrets management - along with strong security fundamentals such as encryption and TLS.

  • Production Ownership - Experience operating the services you build: on-call, observability (metrics, logging, and alerting), and keeping latency-sensitive systems reliable.

  • API & Data Modeling - Strong API design (gRPC and REST) and experience modeling multi-tenant identity hierarchies - users, organizations, projects, and resource boundaries.

  • Collaboration Skills - Ability to work with cross-functional teams to align priorities and deliver customer-first solutions.

  • Mentorship Abilities - Experience mentoring engineers and giving thoughtful, constructive code reviews.

  • Communication Skills - Exceptional ability to articulate complex ideas and align technical solutions with customer and business needs.

Bonus Points

  • Hands-on experience with IAM / authorization frameworks such as Ory, SpiceDB, or OpenFGA.

  • Familiarity with additional identity standards and protocols: SAML, JWT, identity federation, SCIM, and WebAuthn.

  • Experience with cloud-native tooling such as Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, and CI/CD systems.

  • Experience with multi-tenant isolation, audit, or compliance (e.g., SOC 2) for security-critical platforms.

  • Experience with identity for AI agents and agentic workloads, or with GPU / AI cloud infrastructure.

  • Contributions to open-source security, identity, or distributed-systems projects.

You don't need to check every box. If you bring strong fundamentals and are excited about this work, we encourage you to apply, even if you aren't a 100% skill or experience match.

Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation and equity packages

  • Restricted Stock Units

  • Paid time off, paid holidays & leave of absence programs

  • Comprehensive health, dental & vision insurance

  • Employer contributions to HSA account

  • Paid parental leave

  • Paid life insurance, short-term and long-term disability

  • Professional development & tuition reimbursement

  • Mental health & wellness support

  • Commuter benefits (parking & transit)

  • Cell phone stipend

  • 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary

  • Volunteer time off

  • Global travel insurance & emergency assistance

  • Daily meals allowance

  • Additional perks & programs specific to location

Compensation Range

Compensation will be paid in the range of up to $170,000 -$205,000 + Bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicant's knowledge, education, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.

Crusoe is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, citizenship, marital status, sex/gender, sexual preference/ orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, national origin, or any other status protected by law or regulation.

jobs.title: People Research Scientist
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Crusoe is on a mission to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.

We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.

We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.

If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.

About the Role:

We're looking for a People Research Scientist to join our People Science and Workforce Intelligence team. You'll be the research lead for the wider People organization bringing scientific rigor to the questions that matter most as Crusoe scales: how well do we hire, what makes people stay, grow and do great work here, and which of our investments actually make a difference.

The role sits where organizational science, behavioral research and people strategy meet. You'll build frameworks and run systematic research that shape people decisions at one of the fastest-growing companies in AI infrastructure.

You'll study a workforce few people science teams ever see. Our workforce spans a high-growth tech company, a distributed manufacturing operation, and a field organization building and running data centers internationally.

 

What You'll Be Working On:

  • Own research design and scientific inquiry

    • Form and test hypotheses about people programs, employee behavior and workforce outcomes using rigorous experimental and quasi-experimental methods.

    • Run longitudinal studies to learn what creates long-term success, engagement, and retention as we scale.

    • Synthesize external research and industry evidence on people interventions to find best practices and gaps.

    • Partner cross-functionally to design and run systematic studies on employee experience, manager effectiveness and organizational health across corporate, engineering and field teams.

    • Apply sound research ethics and data privacy practices to all employee research.

  • Program effectiveness and impact

    • Build evaluation plans into people programs from the start, including onboarding, manager development, learning, recognition, and retention or compensation programs.

    • Estimate program impact using quasi-experimental methods such as staged rollouts, difference-in-differences, matching and regression discontinuity.

    • Define success measures and leading indicators that tie people programs to business outcomes such as time to productivity, retention of critical talent, and site readiness.

    • Give clear recommendations on what to scale, change or stop.

  • Selection science and hiring research

    • Partner with Talent Acquisition to design and validate structured interviews

    • Run validation studies that link hiring signals to on-the-job performance and retention.

    • Monitor adverse impact and fairness across hiring stages, and advise on legally defensible, job-related selection practices.

    • Evaluate any AI-assisted hiring tools for validity, fairness and candidate experience before and after rollout.

    • Act as a POC for assessment vendor relationships where scale/speed require additional support.

  • Employee listening and survey research

    • Help scale Crusoe's listening strategy, including engagement, pulse and lifecycle surveys.

    • Use psychometric methods to validate survey instruments and make sure measurement is reliable across job families and locations.

    • Reach frontline and field employees, and account for the response and sampling challenges of a distributed workforce.

    • Turn findings into recommendations and actions that leaders can own.

  • Visualization and communication

    • Build clear visualizations that make complex findings easy to understand for different audiences.

    • Present findings and actionable recommendations to executive leadership.

    • Partner with the rest of the People Science & Workforce Intelligence team to build self-service analytics and products that let HR business partners and People team answer their own questions.

 

What You'll Bring to the Team:

  • A Master's or PhD in I/O Psychology, Organizational Behavior, Behavioral Science or a related research field.

  • Intellectual humility that balances rigor with pragmatism.

  • Experience with applied experimental design, hypothesis testing, longitudinal methods and causal inference.

  • Experience with survey design, psychometric methods and employee listening programs.

  • The ability to work with structured and unstructured data via SQL, Python or R

  • Experience in statistical analysis.

  • Comfort working with cross-functional partners in a wide range of business functions

  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to influence stakeholders at every level with data visualization and storytelling skills.

  • You enjoy challenging assumptions with data and changing established practices with objective analysis

  • You enjoy teaching as much as you do learning from others.

 

Bonus Points

  • At least 5 years in research, analytics or related quantitative work, with demonstrated depth in research methods.

  • A background in people analytics specifically.

  • Selection and assessment experience, including validation studies, adverse impact analysis, and familiarity with the Uniform Guidelines and SIOP Principles.

  • Experience evaluating HR or L&D programs with quasi-experimental designs.

  • Deep knowledge of manager effectiveness research and organizational science.

  • Experience studying frontline, field, skilled-trades or operations workforces.

  • Experience at a high-growth technology, AI/ML, energy or infrastructure company.

  • Familiarity with network analysis, NLP for open-text feedback, or advanced statistical methods.

  • Experience with BigQuery, Snowflake, or similar tools.

  • Experience with Workday, Rippling, Ashby, Lattice or TeamOhana.

 

Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation and equity packages

  • Restricted Stock Units

  • Paid time off, paid holidays & leave of absence programs

  • Comprehensive health, dental & vision insurance

  • Employer contributions to HSA account

  • Paid parental leave

  • Paid life insurance, short-term and long-term disability

  • Professional development & tuition reimbursement

  • Mental health & wellness support

  • Commuter benefits (parking & transit)

  • Cell phone stipend

  • 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary

  • Volunteer time off

  • Global travel insurance & emergency assistance

  • Daily meals allowance

  • Additional perks & programs specific to location

     

Compensation Range

Compensation will be paid in the range of up to $160,000 - $195,000 + Bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicant's knowledge, education, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.

 

Crusoe is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, citizenship, marital status, sex/gender, sexual preference/ orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, national origin, or any other status protected by law or regulation.

As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.



We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.



We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.



If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.



About the Role:

Crusoe is building the world's favorite AI-first cloud, and the Identity & Access Management (IAM) team is the security bedrock our customers trust to run their most demanding AI and GPU workloads. IAM sits on the hot path for every request in the cloud, authorizing millions of requests at single-digit-millisecond latency. We are seeking a Staff Software Engineer to set the technical direction for this platform: the fine-grained authorization model, enterprise SSO and identity federation, multi-tenant organization hierarchies, identity for the agentic-AI era, and credential and secrets management. As a Staff Engineer, you will own the multi-quarter architecture across these domains, tackle our most ambiguous, highest-blast-radius problems, and operate as a force multiplier, shaping technical strategy and roadmap with security, product, and leadership, and raising the engineering bar through technical leadership and mentorship.



What You'll Be Working On:

 - Own IAM Architecture & Direction - Set and own the multi-quarter architecture for the fine-grained authorization model, authentication and federation, and identity lifecycle that secure every request in Crusoe's AI cloud.

 - Define Platform-Wide Standards - Own the identity primitives, authorization patterns, and guardrails that keep access control consistent and secure across the entire Crusoe Cloud platform.

 - Drive Build-vs-Buy & Framework Decisions - Lead evaluation and adoption of core IAM technologies, making durable, well-reasoned decisions.

 - Solve the Hardest, Highest-Risk Problems - Take on ambiguous, high-blast-radius initiatives such as scaling the authorization hot path, multi-tenancy, and tenant isolation, balancing security, reliability, and latency.

 - Stay Hands-On - Remain deeply technical: write and review code on the most critical and complex paths, and set the engineering quality bar through your own work.

 - Lead Through Influence - Drive cross-team technical alignment, author design reviews and RFCs, and steer execution across multiple teams without direct authority.

 - Champion Security at Scale - Lead threat modeling and secure-by-design practices for systems on the critical path of every request.

 - Multiply the Team - Mentor senior and mid-level engineers, raise the engineering bar, and shape hiring, onboarding, and technical strategy.



What You'll Bring to the Team:

 - Education & Experience - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field (or equivalent practical experience), 8+ years of software engineering experience building production distributed systems in Go, including significant experience with identity, authorization, or other security-critical systems, and a track record of leading the design of large-scale systems.

 - Architectural Leadership - Demonstrated ability to set technical direction and deliver complex, fault-tolerant distributed systems and managed cloud services across multiple teams.

 - Deep Security Expertise - Deep mastery of modern authentication and authorization: OIDC, OAuth2, SAML, and JWT / token exchange; RBAC/ABAC and fine-grained / relationship-based authorization; identity federation and IdP integration; SCIM and identity lifecycle; and credential and secrets management, including threat modeling at scale.

 - Operational Leadership - Proven ownership of production reliability for hot-path services: defining SLOs, building deep observability, and leading incident response and postmortems. Enterprise security and compliance acumen (e.g., SOC 2), since enterprise SSO customers will drive many of the requirements you set.

 - Influence & Communication - Exceptional ability to drive alignment across engineering, security, product, and leadership, and to articulate complex technical trade-offs to any audience.

 - Force-Multiplier Mentorship - Proven record of growing senior engineers, improving engineering standards, and influencing hiring and technical strategy.
   
   

Bonus Points

 - Policy-as-code and modern authorization engines - OPA, Cedar, or Zanzibar-style systems such as SpiceDB and OpenFGA.

 - Experience with identity for AI agents and agentic workloads.

 - Experience building for or operating GPU / AI cloud infrastructure.

 - Enterprise compliance experience beyond SOC 2, such as FedRAMP or other regulated-environment frameworks.

You don't need to check every box. If you bring deep expertise in several of these areas and are excited about this work, we encourage you to apply even if you aren't a 100% skill or experience match.



Benefits:

 - Competitive compensation and equity packages

 - Restricted Stock Units

 - Paid time off, paid holidays & leave of absence programs

 - Comprehensive health, dental & vision insurance

 - Employer contributions to HSA account

 - Paid parental leave

 - Paid life insurance, short-term and long-term disability

 - Professional development & tuition reimbursement

 - Mental health & wellness support

 - Commuter benefits (parking & transit)

 - Cell phone stipend

 - 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary

 - Volunteer time off

 - Global travel insurance & emergency assistance

 - Daily meals allowance

 - Additional perks & programs specific to location



Compensation Range

Compensation will be paid in the range of up to $215,000 - $260,000 + Bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicant's knowledge, education, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.

Crusoe is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, citizenship, marital status, sex/gender, sexual preference/ orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, national origin, or any other status protected by law or regulation.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Crusoe is on a mission to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.

We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.

If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.

About the Role:

At Crusoe, we are building the "engine room" of the AI revolution. We are seeking a Staff Cloud Hypervisor R&D Engineer to serve as the lead architect for our next-generation virtualization stack. In this role, you will move beyond standard virtualization to design a "Greenfield" hypervisor environment where GPUs, DPUs, and high-speed interconnects are first-class citizens. You will be responsible for eliminating the "virtualization tax," ensuring our cloud infrastructure delivers bare-metal performance for the world’s most demanding AI/ML workloads.

What You'll Be Working On:

  • Next-Gen Hypervisor Architecture: Lead the R&D and implementation of core hypervisor components (KVM, QEMU, or custom Rust-based solutions) specifically optimized for massive-scale GPU fleets.

  • AI Hardware Virtualization: Develop and refine advanced hardware pass-through and abstraction techniques (SR-IOV, VFIO, mdev) to ensure NVIDIA GPUs and BlueField DPUs operate with near-zero latency in a multi-tenant environment.

  • The "Holy Grail" Challenges: Solve high-stakes technical hurdles such as live migration for AI workloads with 80GB+ VRAM and optimizing PCIe peer-to-peer communication between virtualized accelerators.

  • Performance Research & Profiling: Conduct deep-dive bottleneck analysis across the entire stack—from CPU microarchitecture and MMU virtualization to guest OS scheduling—to minimize jitter and maximize throughput.

  • Open Source Leadership: Actively contribute to and maintain upstream open-source virtualization projects, positioning Crusoe as a thought leader in the Linux kernel and virtualization communities.

  • Security & Isolation: Architect robust security boundaries for AI-native cloud infrastructure, balancing high-performance hardware access with strict multi-tenant isolation and hardening.

What You'll Bring to the Team:

  • 7+ Years of Experience: Proven track record in hypervisor internals, kernel development, or low-level systems programming.

  • Deep Virtualization Expertise: Expert-level knowledge of CPU virtualization (Intel VT-x, AMD-V) and memory virtualization (EPT/NPT, HugePages). You should be comfortable discussing the nuances of VMExit overhead.

  • Hardware-Software Integration: Experience working with specialized AI hardware, including GPUs, InfiniBand/RoCE NICs, and SmartNICs/DPUs.

  • Programming & Tooling: Mastery of C and C++ is required; proficiency in Rust for modern systems programming is highly preferred. Experience with QEMU, KVM, and Linux kernel debugging tools (perf, ftrace, eBPF).

  • I/O Mastery: Deep understanding of VirtIO, vhost-user, and hardware-accelerated I/O paths.

  • Technical Leadership: Experience leading complex, cross-functional projects that bridge the gap between hardware engineering and cloud control planes

Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation and equity packages

  • Restricted Stock Units

  • Paid time off, paid holidays & leave of absence programs

  • Comprehensive health, dental & vision insurance

  • Employer contributions to HSA account

  • Paid parental leave

  • Paid life insurance, short-term and long-term disability

  • Professional development & tuition reimbursement

  • Mental health & wellness support

  • Commuter benefits (parking & transit)

  • Cell phone stipend

  • 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary

  • Volunteer time off

  • Global travel insurance & emergency assistance

  • Daily meals allowance

  • Additional perks & programs specific to location

Compensation Range

Compensation will be paid in the range of up to $215,000 -$260,000 + Bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicant's knowledge, education, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.

Crusoe is an Equal Opportunity Employer. jobs.title: Financial Analyst- Real Estate, Land & Leases
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Crusoe is on a mission to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.

We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.

We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.

If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.

About the Role:

Crusoe is looking for a Financial Analyst, Real Estate, Land & Leases to support the financial due diligence, deal analysis, and lifecycle tracking of land and real estate transactions underpinning Crusoe’s data center campuses. This role works closely with the Director of Real Estate Finance and cross-functional partners to build the models, materials, and tracking tools that keep land and lease decisions moving.

This is a hands-on, detail-oriented role suited to someone early in their finance career who wants exposure to real estate, project finance, and infrastructure deal-making, in a company where land and power access are often the binding constraint on how fast infrastructure gets built. This is a full-time, exempt position.

What You'll Be Working On:

  • Due Diligence Support — Support financial due diligence on prospective land acquisitions, ground leases, and site control agreements, helping evaluate cost basis, tax implications, and site-level economics; assist in gathering and organizing information from Legal, Real Estate, and Power teams on title, easements, zoning, utility access, and environmental factors.

  • Site-Level Financial Modeling — Build and maintain site-level financial models (acquisition cost, ground lease economics, property tax, incentive/abatement value) to support go/no-go TCO investment decisions.

  • Commercial Structure Support — Assist in analyzing land purchase agreements, ground leases, option agreements, and related real estate instruments to help ensure terms align with financing strategy; prepare supporting analysis on how land ownership vs. lease structures affect debt sizing and financeability, working alongside Capital Markets/Project Finance teams.

  • Incentives & Abatements — Help compile materials for negotiating economic development incentives, tax abatements, and PILOT agreements with local and state governments.

  • Lifecycle & Asset Management — Maintain financial tracking of land/real estate assets across their lifecycle, from acquisition through construction and operations; build and update a portfolio-level view of land and lease obligations (payment schedules, escalators, renewal options, purchase options) for forecasts and reporting.

  • Accounting Support — Support Accounting on proper treatment of land, leases (ASC 842), and related capital costs.

  • Cross-Functional Coordination — Act as a day-to-day point of contact for data requests and coordination with Real Estate, Development, Power, Legal, and Project Finance teams.

  • Board & Investor Materials — Prepare financial analysis and supporting materials for board, investor, and lender due diligence related to real estate holdings and site pipeline.

  • Process Scalability — Help build and maintain scalable tracking processes and tools as Crusoe’s land portfolio grows.

What You'll Bring to the Team:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Real Estate, Economics, Accounting, or a related field required.

  • 3+ years of experience in real estate finance, project finance, investment banking, corporate development, or a related analytical role.

  • Strong financial modeling and Excel skills; comfort building and maintaining models from templates or scratch.

  • Familiarity with (or eagerness to learn) ground leases, purchase options, easements, and real estate/economic development incentive structures.

  • Basic understanding of how real estate/land structures interact with project financing (debt sizing, financeability, credit requirements).

  • Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills; able to manage multiple deals/assets simultaneously.

  • Strong communication skills and ability to work cross-functionally with Legal, Development, and Finance teams.

Bonus Points

  • Internship or coursework in data centers, energy, industrial, or infrastructure sectors.

Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation and equity packages

  • Restricted Stock Units

  • Paid time off, paid holidays & leave of absence programs

  • Comprehensive health, dental & vision insurance

  • Employer contributions to HSA account

  • Paid parental leave

  • Paid life insurance, short-term and long-term disability

  • Professional development & tuition reimbursement

  • Mental health & wellness support

  • Commuter benefits (parking & transit)

  • Cell phone stipend

  • 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary

  • Volunteer time off

  • Global travel insurance & emergency assistance

  • Daily meals allowance

  • Additional perks & programs specific to location

Compensation Range

Compensation will be paid in the range of up to $105,000 - $125,000+ Bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicant's knowledge, education, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.

Crusoe is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, citizenship, marital status, sex/gender, sexual preference/ orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, national origin, or any other status protected by law or regulation.

About the Role:

Crusoe.ai is seeking a dynamic and experienced Senior Account Executive to lead our efforts in acquiring and expanding strategic accounts within our Enterprise Digital Native Business (DNB) segment: digital natives with $1B+ in revenue and tech-forward enterprises, including the Fortune 500. You'll be the partner these companies rely on to secure the AI infrastructure behind their most important products. You will be part of an innovative and rapidly growing company, working with cutting-edge technology that is transforming cloud computing by leveraging stranded energy resources to power AI workloads.

You will own a portfolio of Named Accounts, with complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles that unfold over many months and multi-year commitments in the eight to nine figures. Your contributions will directly support Crusoe's mission to drive both growth and sustainability, making a significant impact in the AI cloud space.

What You'll Be Working On:

  • Full Sales Cycle Ownership: Manage the entire sales process, from account planning and qualification to closing high-value, multi-year deals and maintaining long-term client relationships.

  • Collaborate Across Teams: Work closely with Solutions Engineering, Product, Engineering, Data Center, Finance, Legal, and Customer Success teams to deliver customized, high-performance cloud solutions.

  • Engage with C-Level Executives: Build and nurture relationships with key decision-makers across infrastructure, finance, and the C-suite; positioning Crusoe as the preferred partner for their AI cloud infrastructure needs.

  • Lead Complex Negotiations: Lead large, multi-year negotiations, including capacity commitments and complex commercial terms.

  • Drive Revenue Growth: Achieve sales quotas through new customer acquisition, and manage and grow accounts post-sale through capacity expansion and multi-year commitments to ensure continued customer success and satisfaction.

What You'll Bring to the Team:

  • 10+ Years of Enterprise Sales Experience: Proven track record in closing complex, multi-year sales cycles with 7-figure or larger deals, in Majors, Strategic, or Named Account roles, ideally selling cloud, infrastructure, data center, or AI compute at scale, with familiarity in working with hyperscalers like AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.

  • Strategic Thinking & Negotiation Skills: Ability to negotiate large, multi-year contracts, including capacity commitments in the eight to nine figures, and navigate complex procurement, legal, and finance processes with senior counterparts.

  • Relationship Management: Experience owning Named Accounts and nurturing long-term relationships with Digital Native Enterprises, focusing on driving growth through account expansion.

  • Excellent Communication Skills: Ability to engage and influence senior stakeholders including C-suite and technical leaders, effectively communicate technical concepts to non-technical audiences, and collaborate cross-functionally.

  • Structured Sales Approach: A disciplined, structured approach to deal management, pipeline generation, and forecasting.

Bonus Points

  • Experience selling GPU or AI compute with capacity commitments

  • Hyperscaler or large-scale infrastructure background

  • Training in MEDDPICC, Command of the Message, or Force Management

About the Role:

We're looking for a People Research Scientist to join our People Science and Workforce Intelligence team. You'll be the research lead for the wider People organization bringing scientific rigor to the questions that matter most as Crusoe scales: how well do we hire, what makes people stay, grow and do great work here, and which of our investments actually make a difference.

The role sits where organizational science, behavioral research and people strategy meet. You'll build frameworks and run systematic research that shape people decisions at one of the fastest-growing companies in AI infrastructure.

You'll study a workforce few people science teams ever see. Our workforce spans a high-growth tech company, a distributed manufacturing operation, and a field organization building and running data centers internationally.

 

What You'll Be Working On:

  • Own research design and scientific inquiry

    • Form and test hypotheses about people programs, employee behavior and workforce outcomes using rigorous experimental and quasi-experimental methods.

    • Run longitudinal studies to learn what creates long-term success, engagement, and retention as we scale.

    • Synthesize external research and industry evidence on people interventions to find best practices and gaps.

    • Partner cross-functionally to design and run systematic studies on employee experience, manager effectiveness and organizational health across corporate, engineering and field teams.

    • Apply sound research ethics and data privacy practices to all employee research.

  • Program effectiveness and impact

    • Build evaluation plans into people programs from the start, including onboarding, manager development, learning, recognition, and retention or compensation programs.

    • Estimate program impact using quasi-experimental methods such as staged rollouts, difference-in-differences, matching and regression discontinuity.

    • Define success measures and leading indicators that tie people programs to business outcomes such as time to productivity, retention of critical talent, and site readiness.

    • Give clear recommendations on what to scale, change or stop.

  • Selection science and hiring research

    • Partner with Talent Acquisition to design and validate structured interviews

    • Run validation studies that link hiring signals to on-the-job performance and retention.

    • Monitor adverse impact and fairness across hiring stages, and advise on legally defensible, job-related selection practices.

    • Evaluate any AI-assisted hiring tools for validity, fairness and candidate experience before and after rollout.

    • Act as a POC for assessment vendor relationships where scale/speed require additional support.

  • Employee listening and survey research

    • Help scale Crusoe's listening strategy, including engagement, pulse and lifecycle surveys.

    • Use psychometric methods to validate survey instruments and make sure measurement is reliable across job families and locations.

    • Reach frontline and field employees, and account for the response and sampling challenges of a distributed workforce.

    • Turn findings into recommendations and actions that leaders can own.

  • Visualization and communication

    • Build clear visualizations that make complex findings easy to understand for different audiences.

    • Present findings and actionable recommendations to executive leadership.

    • Partner with the rest of the People Science & Workforce Intelligence team to build self-service analytics and products that let HR business partners and People team answer their own questions.

 

What You'll Bring to the Team:

  • A Master's or PhD in I/O Psychology, Organizational Behavior, Behavioral Science or a related research field.

  • Intellectual humility that balances rigor with pragmatism.

  • Experience with applied experimental design, hypothesis testing, longitudinal methods and causal inference.

  • Experience with survey design, psychometric methods and employee listening programs.

  • The ability to work with structured and unstructured data via SQL, Python or R

  • Experience in statistical analysis.

  • Comfort working with cross-functional partners in a wide range of business functions

  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to influence stakeholders at every level with data visualization and storytelling skills.

  • You enjoy challenging assumptions with data and changing established practices with objective analysis

  • You enjoy teaching as much as you do learning from others.

 

Bonus Points

  • At least 5 years in research, analytics or related quantitative work, with demonstrated depth in research methods.

  • A background in people analytics specifically.

  • Selection and assessment experience, including validation studies, adverse impact analysis, and familiarity with the Uniform Guidelines and SIOP Principles.

  • Experience evaluating HR or L&D programs with quasi-experimental designs.

  • Deep knowledge of manager effectiveness research and organizational science.

  • Experience studying frontline, field, skilled-trades or operations workforces.

  • Experience at a high-growth technology, AI/ML, energy or infrastructure company.

  • Familiarity with network analysis, NLP for open-text feedback, or advanced statistical methods.

  • Experience with BigQuery, Snowflake, or similar tools.

  • Experience with Workday, Rippling, Ashby, Lattice or TeamOhana.

 

Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation and equity packages

  • Restricted Stock Units

  • Paid time off, paid holidays & leave of absence programs

  • Comprehensive health, dental & vision insurance

  • Employer contributions to HSA account

  • Paid parental leave

  • Paid life insurance, short-term and long-term disability

  • Professional development & tuition reimbursement

  • Mental health & wellness support

  • Commuter benefits (parking & transit)

  • Cell phone stipend

  • 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary

  • Volunteer time off

  • Global travel insurance & emergency assistance

  • Daily meals allowance

  • Additional perks & programs specific to location

     

Compensation Range

Compensation will be paid in the range of up to $140,000 - $170,000 + Bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicant's knowledge, education, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.

 

Crusoe is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, citizenship, marital status, sex/gender, sexual preference/ orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, national origin, or any other status protected by law or regulation.

jobs.title: Staff Technical Program Manager, Firmware Lifecycle and Release Management
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Crusoe is on a mission to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.

We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.

We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.

If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.

About the Role:

Crusoe Cloud runs AI infrastructure at a scale where a single firmware or software baseline can determine whether thousands of GPUs deliver for our customers. As a Staff Technical Program Manager, you will own the end-to-end release lifecycle for versioned firmware and software baselines across our GPU fleet. That covers everything from scoping and qualification through phased rollout and production deployment. This is a builder role: you will run complex releases across Compute, Networking, Storage, Orchestration, and Operations, and you will design the release calendars, validation frameworks, and metrics that let Crusoe scale them predictably.

We’re looking for an engineer-rooted TPM who is comfortable in the white space between teams and who earns trust with engineers and vendors through technical depth and execution rigor. You’ll identify risks before they surface, drive alignment across engineering leads without direct authority, and give leadership clear, data-driven decision points. This is a full-time position.

What You'll Be Working On:

  • Own the Release Lifecycle End to End: Lead versioned firmware and software baselines from scoping and definition through qualification, validation, phased rollout, and production deployment across a large GPU fleet.

  • Orchestrate Cross-Functional Releases: Drive release programs across Compute, Networking, Storage, Orchestration, and Operations. Set entry and exit criteria, layered validation, domain sign-offs, and go/no-go decisions.

  • Lead Fleet-Wide Upgrade Campaigns: Coordinate upgrades on live production clusters with Operations and customer-facing teams, including maintenance planning, rollback strategies, and risk mitigation.

  • Drive Security and CVE Response: Partner with engineering leads to make fast, well-reasoned decisions on security patches and CVEs, and fold them into the release train.

  • Govern Vendor Relationships: Work with OEMs, ODMs, and component and silicon suppliers on firmware fixes, validation timelines, and roadmaps. Escalate and resolve issues that put Crusoe’s schedule at risk.

  • Build the Machine: Design lightweight, scalable release calendars, validation frameworks, Jira workflows, and metrics that make Crusoe’s release process predictable as the fleet grows.

  • Surface Risk and Drive Decisions: Maintain real-time visibility into release health, map cross-team dependencies, and deliver crisp executive updates that spotlight decisions and trade-offs.

  • Improve Continuously: Lead retrospectives after major releases and feed the learnings back into the process. Apply AI tools to improve tracking, risk detection, and communication across your programs.

What You'll Bring to the Team:

  • Program Leadership at Scale: 10+ years as a Technical Program Manager in infrastructure, hardware, or platform engineering, including release or change management at fleet scale.

  • Server Firmware Expertise: Working knowledge of the server firmware stack, including BMC, BIOS, GPU firmware and drivers, and NIC and switch firmware.

  • Influence Without Authority: Proven experience running validation or qualification programs across many engineering teams without direct authority.

  • Risk and Dependency Management: Ability to anticipate what will break before it does, then drive mitigation plans and rollback strategies for live production environments.

  • Process Builder’s Mindset: Track record of creating fit-for-purpose frameworks, such as release calendars, validation gates, and metrics, rather than forcing programs into rigid templates.

  • Executive Communication: Ability to translate complex technical status into clear, data-driven updates and decision-ready recommendations.

  • Educational Foundation: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience.

Bonus Points

  • Experience at a GPU cloud provider or hyperscaler managing large-scale fleets (thousands of nodes).

  • A track record of driving firmware currency and compliance programs across a production fleet.

  • Hands-on experience with vendor escalation management, including driving OEM/ODM and silicon partners to fix and validate firmware on tight timelines.

  • Familiarity with AI accelerator platforms and the dependencies between firmware, drivers, and cluster networking.

  • A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation and equity packages

  • Restricted Stock Units

  • Paid time off, paid holidays & leave of absence programs

  • Comprehensive health, dental & vision insurance

  • Employer contributions to HSA account

  • Paid parental leave

  • Paid life insurance, short-term and long-term disability

  • Professional development & tuition reimbursement

  • Mental health & wellness support

  • Commuter benefits (parking & transit)

  • Cell phone stipend

  • 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary

  • Volunteer time off

  • Global travel insurance & emergency assistance

  • Daily meals allowance

  • Additional perks & programs specific to location

Compensation Range

Compensation will be paid in the range of up to $200,000 - $240,000 + Bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicant's knowledge, education, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.

Crusoe is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, citizenship, marital status, sex/gender, sexual preference/ orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, national origin, or any other status protected by law or regulation.

We're the glue between product, design, and the platform teams that power Crusoe Cloud.

In 2026 our focus is one experience, one quality bar across every surface; a shared design system, a single API/CLI style guide extended to MCP and Terraform, and a foundation solid enough to support the polish, defaults, and micro-interactions that make a developer cloud feel great to use.

You'd be the first dedicated quality engineer on the team, and the person who defines what "one quality bar" means in practice.

If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.

About the Role:

Crusoe's Finance team is looking for a Senior Financial Analyst to own headcount and operating expense (OpEx) finance across the company. This role is the single source of truth for how many people we have, how many we're planning to hire, and what we're spending outside of capital projects — and it's responsible for the planning, budgeting, forecasting, and actuals reporting that keeps leadership and the business aligned on both. You'll partner with People, Recruiting, and department leaders on headcount planning, own the OpEx budget process end-to-end, and make sure monthly actuals tell an accurate, timely story against plan. This is a highly visible role for someone who wants to bring structure and rigor to how a scaling company manages its people and operating costs.

What You'll Be Working On:

  • Headcount Planning & Tracking: own the headcount plan and forecast across the company, partnering with People and department leaders to track open reqs, hiring pace, and attrition against plan

  • OpEx Budgeting/forecasting: lead the annual budgeting and in-year OpEx forecasting process across departments, working with budget owners to build defensible, well-documented plans

  • Actuals Reporting & Variance Analysis: own monthly and quarterly actuals reporting for headcount and OpEx, identifying variances to plan and partnering with budget owners on root cause and corrective action

  • Forecast Management: maintain rolling headcount and OpEx forecasts, updating for approved changes, hiring plan shifts, and in-year business decisions

  • Business Partnering: serve as the go-to finance contact for department leaders on headcount and OpEx questions, helping them understand their budgets and make informed trade-offs. Partner with HR on new or changing benefit ideas to improve employee’s experience. Additionally, partner with Marketing and other leaders on OPEX budgets / plans and associated ROI

  • Process & Systems Improvement: improve the tools and processes used to plan, track, and report on headcount and OpEx, reducing manual reconciliation and increasing self-serve visibility for stakeholders

  • Executive & Board Reporting: prepare clear, accurate headcount and OpEx reporting packages for executive leadership and the board

What You'll Bring to the Team:

  • 3+ years of progressive finance experience, including meaningful ownership of headcount and/or OpEx planning and reporting

  • Strong financial modeling skills, with advanced proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets and experience with planning tools (e.g., Anaplan, Adaptive, Workday, or similar)

  • Demonstrated ability to partner with People/Recruiting teams and translate hiring plans into financial impact

  • Track record of owning a budgeting and actuals reporting process end-to-end, including variance analysis and stakeholder communication

  • Excellent attention to detail and a strong sense of ownership over data accuracy — headcount and OpEx numbers get scrutinized by leadership every month

  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain budget and variance drivers clearly to non-finance stakeholders

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field; MBA a plus

Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation and equity packages

  • Restricted Stock Units

  • Paid time off, paid holidays & leave of absence programs

  • Comprehensive health, dental & vision insurance

  • Employer contributions to HSA account

  • Paid parental leave

  • Paid life insurance, short-term and long-term disability

  • Professional development & tuition reimbursement

  • Mental health & wellness support

  • Commuter benefits (parking & transit)

  • Cell phone stipend

  • 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary

  • Volunteer time off

  • Global travel insurance & emergency assistance

  • Daily meals allowance

  • Additional perks & programs specific to location

Compensation Range

Compensation will be paid in the range of up to $130,000 - $160,000 + Bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicant's knowledge, education, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.

Crusoe is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, citizenship, marital status, sex/gender, sexual preference/ orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, national origin, or any other status protected by law or regulation.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Crusoe is on a mission to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.

We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.

We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.

If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.

About the Role:

We're looking for a People Science Consultant to be the strategic analytics advisor to our People Success Partners (PSPs) and the leaders they support. You'll take on the complex, high-stakes questions that don't fit in a dashboard, and turn them into clear recommendations that shape decisions about talent, teams and organization.

You'll be embedded with our PSPs and the leaders they support, a trusted thought partner and data driven consultant. Through a mix of analysis, enablement, and partnership, you'll make sure insights land in the business and lead to real change.

The role is equal parts behavioral scientist and consultant. You'll bring research rigor to messy business problems, and the judgment to know which questions are worth answering.

You'll support a workforce few people analytics teams ever see. It spans a high-growth tech company, a distributed manufacturing operation, and a field organization building and running data centers internationally. What drives retention for a software engineer is very different from what drives it for a data center technician, and you'll help each part of the business understand its own people.

What You'll Be Working On:

  • Advise PSPs and business leaders

    • Serve as the dedicated analytics partner to our PSPs and their client organizations, such as Engineering, Data Center Operations, Manufacturing and G&A.

    • Take on complex questions, like transforming engagement results into meaningful change, or whether a reorganization will fix a team's execution problems, and turn them into focused analyses with clear recommendations.

    • Work from hypotheses: frame the question, decide what evidence would change the decision, and get to a credible answer quickly.

    • Help PSPs walk into business reviews, talent reviews and org design conversations with a point of view backed by evidence.

    • Help PSPs prioritize, and push back when a request won't lead to a decision.

    • Handle high-visibility requests, such as board materials, market comparisons and executive questions, with speed and accuracy.

  • Diagnose complex people problems and connect them to business outcomes

    • Lead deep dives when something changes, such as a spike in turnover at a site or a drop in engagement on a team.

    • Combine quantitative analysis with interviews, focus groups and open-text feedback to explain not just what is happening but why.

    • Analyze org health and structure, including span of control, layers and manager ratios, and assess the people impact of reorganizations.

    • Connect people data to business outcomes, such as how staffing stability affects site performance or how manager changes affect team retention.

    • Help leaders set realistic people targets for attrition, spans, ramp time and hiring quality, using internal history and external benchmarks.

  • Shape talent decisions

    • Provide analysis that supports performance calibration, including rating distributions, consistency checks and fairness reviews.

    • Measure whether the programs PSPs launch are moving the outcomes they were meant to move, and bring in our research partner when a program needs a rigorous evaluation.

  • Work embedded in the business

    • Join PSP and leadership forums so you understand each organization's priorities and spot people issues early.

    • Turn work from the wider People Science and Workforce Intelligence team into recommendations leaders can act on, and bring real business problems back to shape the research and capability roadmap.

    • Make sure PSPs and leaders know the full range of what the team can do, including the self-service tools they already have, and help them use it.

    • Build data fluency across the PSP team by coaching partners to read data with confidence and use the team's tools on their own.

    • Make sure conclusions are sound and clearly separate what the data show from what it suggests.

What You'll Bring to the Team:

  • An advanced degree in a behavioral science or quantitative field, such as I/O Psychology, Behavioral Economics, Organizational Behavior, Statistics or Economics, or a master’s degree plus substantial experience in management consulting or analytics.

  • 4+ years in people analytics, management consulting or a related analytical role, including time spent advising senior leaders directly

  • Solid grounding in research design and inferential statistics, so you can tell a real effect from noise and explain the difference to a skeptical executive.

  • Strong Exploratory Data Analysis skills. You're comfortable getting into the data yourself to answer a question.

  • Consulting skills: you can scope an unclear request, manage several stakeholders, and say no when it's the right call.

  • A strong grasp of HR processes and people metrics, including where metrics mislead and need deeper analysis.

  • The ability to explain complex analysis to non-technical audiences, from PSPs to senior executives.

  • Hands-on experience using AI tools to speed up analysis or build lightweight tools, not just curiosity about them.

  • Comfort with ambiguity and a fast pace. You'd rather deliver a useful answer this week than a perfect one next quarter.

Bonus Points

  • Experience in management consulting, internal strategy or a similar role where you owned the full arc of a problem: framing the question, forming hypotheses, doing the analysis and getting leaders to act.

  • Experience with Python or R.

  • Experience with qualitative research methods, such as interviews and focus groups.

  • Experience supporting frontline, manufacturing, field or operations workforces.

  • Experience at a high-growth technology, AI/ML, energy or infrastructure company.

  • Experience with BigQuery, dbt and Sigma.

  • Experience with Workday, position management concepts, and listening platforms

Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation and equity packages

  • Restricted Stock Units

  • Paid time off, paid holidays & leave of absence programs

  • Comprehensive health, dental & vision insurance

  • Employer contributions to HSA account

  • Paid parental leave

  • Paid life insurance, short-term and long-term disability

  • Professional development & tuition reimbursement

  • Mental health & wellness support

  • Commuter benefits (parking & transit)

  • Cell phone stipend

  • 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary

  • Volunteer time off

  • Global travel insurance & emergency assistance

  • Daily meals allowance

  • Additional perks & programs specific to location

Compensation Range

Compensation will be paid in the range of up to $160,000 - $195,000 + Bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicant's knowledge, education, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.

Crusoe is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, citizenship, marital status, sex/gender, sexual preference/ orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, national origin, or any other status protected by law or regulation.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Crusoe is on a mission to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads.
